title: IT Coordinator
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION: Forbright is a nationwide full-service bank and commercial lender focused on helping to build a brighter future for our clients and the communities we serve. Forbright is committed to exceptional client service by providing seamless, innovative personal banking services to depositors and creative financing solutions to visionary middle market businesses and investors in healthcare, technology, financial services, real estate, and other industries.
COMPANY CULTURE: We are a dynamic, high energy, fun, and fast-paced organization that has an exciting growth trajectory, meaningful mission, and embedded responsible practices into our daily interactions. We offer our team members a culture of collaboration, inclusion, flexibility, recognition, and giving back. We look to hire individuals that are passionate about our mission, and who are motivated, customer and results-oriented, innovative, adaptable, and thoughtful.
COMPANY MISSION: We are a mission-driven institution. We operate a sound dynamic institution that is well capitalized, liquid, profitable and uses best practices to manage risk and assure compliance with laws and regulations. We use Forbright’s capital, capabilities, innovation, and expertise to help our clients succeed and contribute broadly to building a brighter future.

JOB SUMMARY: The IT Coordinator is responsible for supporting the maintenance and enhancement of IT-related matters. This includes inventory and billing tasks for the department and organization, inventory and asset control, software licensing management and tracking, onboarding/departure processing, audit-related tasks, application access controls, vendor relationships, and overall administrative support to the technology department.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Manage vendor invoices and work closely with the Finance/Accounting department(s) to ensure they are paid accurately and on time

  • Maintain IT budget by recording and monitoring monthly expenses, including submitting monthly expense reports

  • Manage asset inventory solutions for the company-wide software and equipment, including IT licenses and agreements

  • Fulfill software and hardware purchase requests, ensuring purchases are cost-effective and compliant with IT policies

  • Collaborate with HR and IT teams to manage onboarding and offboarding processes

  • Arrange and prepare equipment for shipping/receiving and distribution accurately and promptly

  • Manage contracts and purchasing with vendors and suppliers, including managing invoicing and payment processes

  • Record purchases, perform physical inventory audits, and maintain and reconcile inventory records

  • Assist with projects and operational tasks assigned by the management team

  • Spearhead the planning, organizing, and executing departmental volunteer initiatives, fostering team engagement and ensuring broad participation

  • Track volunteer hours to achieve departmental goals in conjunction with Bank goals

  • Maintain and organize IT storage room and replenish inventory as needed

  • Perform other duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High School Diploma required; Bachelor’s Degree preferred

  • Minimum 2 years of administrative experience required, focus within Information Technology strongly preferred

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools (Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Excel)

  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

  • Outstanding problem-solving and time management skills

  • Self-motivated, self-directed, and results-oriented

  • Adaptable and able to multitask in a fast-paced environment

  • Can work independently and within a team; solution-oriented with a collaborative approach

POSITION REQUIREMENTS: We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees are capable of performing their job position. Work is primarily conducted in an office setting while certain positions may allow for remote work through the use of technology at management discretion. The functions described below are representative of those to successfully perform duties of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable employees to perform the essential functions. While performing duties of this job, the employee may be regularly required for extended periods of time to:
• Remain in a stationary position
• Use hands and fingers
• Utilize a computer monitor with visual acuity
• Operate technology or other office machinery such as printers, scanners, etc.
• Communicate clearly verbally and/or in writing with others
ADDITIONAL DUTIES: For Forbright Bank to remain efficient and nimble as a growing organization, team members are expected to exhibit a high level of flexibility regarding any duties that may be situationally assigned outside of this job description.
PERKS/BENEFITS:
• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans
• 4 weeks PTO
• 401k + company match
• Metro SmartTrip benefits ($50/mo)
• Remote or hybrid (4 days per week in-office) work schedules for most positions
• Incentives for purchasing solar panels, electric vehicles, biking to work, etc.
• Paid subscriptions to Veterans Compost, Capital Bikeshare, Imperfect Foods reimbursement, and more!
• The Washington Post Top Workplaces winner for four consecutive years (2023-2026)
CORE PRINCIPLES:
• Excellence: Excellence is not a goal, but a standard, reflected in the precision of our work and the quality of our decisions. Excellence is a discipline that compounds over time and creates lasting value; it must be measured and managed.
• People: Our people are our greatest strength. We foster a culture of respect, inclusion, and ambition - where everyone matters. We celebrate collaboration and teamwork and prize loyalty - to one another, the company, our mission, and values.
• Innovation: We invest boldly in technology, harnessing innovation not for its own sake but to make banking and lending better, faster, and smarter for our clients, more efficient for our team, and more profitable for our shareholders. By combining human insight with technological excellence, we strengthen our ability to serve, to adapt, and to succeed in a changing world. Innovation is a continuous investment in new ideas.
• Sound Practices: Our foundation rests on prudence, care, integrity, and discipline. We manage credit and business risk with rigor and fundamentals-based judgment, act with transparency, and uphold the highest standards of corporate governance and regulatory compliance to ensure sustainable growth and enduring financial strength.
• Distinct Value: We focus our energy where we add value. We avoid the commoditized and the ordinary, choosing to compete through insight, specialization, technology and service. By concentrating on areas where expertise matters and relationships endure, we create differentiation that is defensible and lasting.
• Clients: We exist to advance our clients’ success and to help them grow. We listen deeply, think creatively, and deliver solutions that solve problems, drive impact and add value. Every client relationship is built on partnership, performance, and purpose.
• Shareholders: We are committed to creating exceptional value for our shareholders. We invest for the long term and view our shareholders as partners – not observers - in value creation. We allocate capital wisely, execute with precision, and continuously adapt our business model to pursue the most attractive, risk-adjusted returns. We work to make rational decisions, avoid unnecessary complexity, maintain strong liquidity and capital, and communicate with clarity and honesty. We measure success both by current performance and by the durability and quality of the long-term value we build.
• Communities and the Environment: We believe prosperity and responsibility go hand in hand. We invest in inclusive opportunity and environmental stewardship. Our goal is simple - to do our part build a brighter, more sustainable future for the communities we serve and the world we share.
It is the policy of Forbright Bank to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals and to administer all aspects and conditions of pre-employment and employment without regard to protected characteristics.
Employment with Forbright Bank is at-will, which means that either you or the Company may terminate the relationship at any time.
By applying, you acknowledge that you have reviewed our CCPA Privacy Notice.

title: Anchor Reporter
description:

You will enterprise exclusives, tell compelling stories, and complete live shots. At Hearst Television we tell stories every day. Stories about people of all backgrounds, perspectives, and identities. title: Private Client Banker - Seacliff Branch - Huntington Beach CA
description:
You have a passion for taking care of our customers and employees and making them feel welcomed and valued by building lasting relationships, doing the right thing, exceeding expectations and having a strong commitment to diversity and inclusion. Here at Chase, you will have the opportunity to help people experience our Customer Promise -- helping people make the most of their money so they can make the most of their lives by providing education and advice tailored to suit their financial needs.

As a Private Client Banker in Branch Banking, you are the main point of contact for a select group of Chase’s affluent clients as well as other customers in the Branch. You will manage their complete banking relationship across the company, utilizing a proactive and disciplined approach to generate growth in their balances. You will help acquire new clients by actively soliciting referrals and developing internal and external sources.

Job responsibilities

  • Shares the value of Chase Private Client with clients that may be eligible
  • Actively manages their banking relationship through an advice-based approach, ensuring each client receives the best products and services for their needs
  • Partners with Specialists (Private Client Advisors, Mortgage Bankers and Business Relationship Managers) to connect customers to experts who can help them with specialized financial needs
  • Makes lives of clients more convenient by sharing and setting up self-service options to access their accounts 24 hours a day/ 7 days a week
  • Adheres to policies, procedures, and regulatory banking requirements

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Demonstrated success using a value-added, relationship-oriented approach to acquire and deepen client relationships
  • 1+ year Branch Banking Banker or equivalent experience in financial services, with verifiable success in new client acquisition, cultivating, and maintaining customer relationships and revenue generation
  • Beginning Oct. 1, 2018, if you are not currently registered, the Securities Industry Essential (SIE) exam, FINRA Series 6/7, state registration (including 63 or 66 if required) and Life licenses are required - or must be successfully completed within 180 days of starting the role
  • Compliance with Dodd Frank/Truth in Lending Act*
  • High school degree, GED, or foreign equivalent
  • Adherence to policies, procedures, and regulatory banking requirements
  • Ability to work branch hours, including weekends and some evenings

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Excellent communication skills
  • College degree or military equivalent
  • Experience cultivating relationships with affluent clients
  • Strong team orientation with a commitment of long-term career with the firm

Federal Deposit Insurance Act

This position is subject to Section 19 of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act. As such, an employment offer for this position is contingent on JPMorganChase’s review of criminal conviction history, including pretrial diversions or program entries.

Dodd Frank/Truth in Lending Act

This position is subject to the Dodd Frank/Truth in Lending Act qualification requirements for Loan Originators. As such, an employment offer for this position is contingent on JPMC's review of your criminal conviction history, credit report, information available through NMLS, and any other information relevant to a determination by JPMC that you demonstrate financial responsibility, good character, and general fitness for the position. Note that any felony conviction within the last seven years will disqualify you from consideration for this position. Your continued employment in this position would be contingent upon compliance with Truth in Lending Act/Dodd Frank Loan Originator requirements.

In addition, this position requires National Mortgage Licensing System and Registry (NMLS) registration under the SAFE Act of 2008. As such, upon active employment with JPMorgan Chase, you will be required to either register on NMLS, or to update your existing registration as necessary to grant access to and reflect your employment with JPMorgan Chase. Your continued employment in this position with JPMorgan Chase is contingent upon compliance with the SAFE Act, including successful registration immediately after your start date, and timely completion of annual renewal and required updates thereafter.

Any information obtained during the registration, update, and renewal processes or through NMLS notifications may impact your employment with the firm. Any of the completed information you provide during the Chase on-line application process may be transferred, on your behalf, to NMLS by JPMorgan Chase. Please carefully review the information you provide to Chase for accuracy and consistency and with any current NMLS record, if applicable, before submitting. Further information about NMLS and registration requirements of registration can be found at: https://mortgage.nationwidelicensingsystem.org/Safe/SitePages/default.aspx

title: Space Auditor - #852
description:
Space Auditor

Location: Reston, VA

TS/SCI REQUIRED/Current CI Poly

Responsibilities:

  • Support the FLS Space Management Team in maintaining accurate space, occupancy, and utilization data.
  • Coordinate directly with Directorate and Office Space Coordinators, Site Chiefs, Building Managers, and other stakeholders involved in space allocation and facility use.
  • Gather, analyze, and coordinate customer space and occupancy requirements.
  • Conduct facility and site walks to validate existing conditions, seating assignments, occupancy levels, and personnel bed-downs.
  • Perform field measurements and verify room dimensions, layouts, and space configurations.
  • Update floor plans and seating allocations based on audit findings and facility changes.
  • Resolve spatial orientation, floor plan, and occupancy discrepancies within assigned facilities.
  • Develop and revise space layouts using AutoCAD and Revit.
  • Read and interpret blueprints, floor plans, architectural drawings, and facility documentation.
  • Maintain accurate accounting of space usage, capacity, occupancy, and vacancy.
  • Use ARCHIBUS Computer-Aided Facility Management software to update records and generate utilization reports.
  • Pull and analyze capacity, occupancy, vacancy, and utilization data from the ARCHIBUS database.
  • Assist government personnel in identifying and resolving immediate and future space planning and occupancy needs.
  • Support strategic space planning, occupancy planning, and facility planning initiatives.
  • Assist Space Planners in identifying gaps and discrepancies in 1450 and 1450-1 accountable spaces.
  • Assemble and analyze building usage information to support planning, reporting, and compliance processes.
  • Prepare written reports, presentations, and communications for senior leadership.
  • Facilitate internal, public, and stakeholder meetings or workshops when applicable.
  • Manage multiple projects and assignments simultaneously while prioritizing work in accordance with leadership expectations.
  • Perform space audits at facilities worldwide, including domestic and international travel, on a bi-monthly or quarterly basis or more frequently as required by the customer.

Qualifications:

  • Active TS/SCI clearance with CI Polygraph
  • Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Interior Design, Facilities Management, Engineering, Planning, or a related field and 6+ years of experience or 10+ years of experience in lieu of a degree.
  • Experience supporting space management, occupancy planning, facility planning, space auditing, or a related function.
  • Prior experience using ARCHIBUS or a comparable Computer-Aided Facility Management system.
  • Proficiency with AutoCAD and Revit for reviewing, developing, or updating facility floor plans and space layouts.
  • Experience conducting space audits, facility assessments, occupancy validations, or personnel bed-down reviews.
  • Ability to perform field measurements and accurately document facility conditions.
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, architectural drawings, and floor plans.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, SharePoint, and Adobe products.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate with and prepare materials for senior leadership.
  • Strong customer service and stakeholder coordination skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally, including periodic overseas travel.

Desired:

  • Experience with strategic space planning, occupancy planning, facilities planning, and workplace utilization analysis.
  • Familiarity with federal space accountability requirements, including 1450 and 1450-1 accountable spaces.
  • Experience maintaining space inventory, occupancy, and utilization data for large or geographically dispersed facility portfolios.

title: PM EXTRUDER OPERATOR
description:
Job Summary:

The Extruder Operator is responsible for operating and maintaining extruder equipment to produce plastic materials used in packaging. This role includes performing startups, monitoring product quality, troubleshooting, and routine maintenance on high-speed extrusion equipment. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, safety-conscious, and capable of working independently in a fast-paced production environment, supporting Hickman’s commitment to efficient and quality packaging production.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Operate and monitor extruder equipment, ensuring consistent flow and quality of extruded plastic material.

  • Perform equipment startups, calibrations, and shutdowns according to standard operating procedures.

  • Build pallets of finished products and ensure proper labeling and storage.

  • Utilize the HMI (Human-Machine Interface) for machine controls, making minor adjustments to optimize production.

  • Regularly inspect product quality, check for defects or overfilling, and take corrective action as needed.

  • Monitor coil levels and refill as necessary to prevent machine stoppages or collisions.

  • Obtain forklift and pallet jack OSHA certification; assist with moving raw materials and finished products as required.

  • Maintain a clean and organized work area, following all safety and GMP protocols.

  • Assist maintenance team in troubleshooting and repairing machinery when technical issues arise.

Resumen del Puesto:

El Operador de Extrusora es responsable de operar y mantener el equipo de extrusión para producir materiales plásticos utilizados en el empaque. Este puesto incluye realizar arranques, monitorear la calidad del producto, resolver problemas y realizar mantenimiento rutinario en equipos de extrusión de alta velocidad. El candidato ideal es detallista, consciente de la seguridad y capaz de trabajar de manera independiente en un entorno de producción de ritmo rápido, apoyando el compromiso de Hickman’s con una producción de empaque eficiente y de alta calidad.

Funciones y Responsabilidades:

  • Operar y monitorear el equipo de extrusión, asegurando un flujo constante y calidad uniforme del material plástico extruido.

  • Realizar arranques, calibraciones y apagados del equipo según los procedimientos operativos estándar.

  • Armar tarimas con los productos terminados y asegurar el etiquetado y almacenamiento adecuados.

  • Utilizar la interfaz HMI (Interfaz Humano-Máquina) para controlar la máquina, haciendo ajustes menores para optimizar la producción.

  • Inspeccionar regularmente la calidad del producto, verificar defectos o sobrellenado, y tomar acciones correctivas cuando sea necesario.

  • Monitorear los niveles de bobina y rellenar según sea necesario para evitar paros o colisiones en la máquina.

  • Obtener la certificación OSHA para el uso de montacargas y patines hidráulicos; asistir en el movimiento de materiales y productos terminados cuando se requiera.

  • Mantener un área de trabajo limpio y organizada, siguiendo todos los protocolos de seguridad y Buenas Prácticas de Manufactura (GMP).

  • Apoyar al equipo de mantenimiento en la resolución de problemas y reparación del equipo cuando surjan fallas técnicas.

title: Research Associate
description:
Summary of the Role

The Research Associate will serve as the primary participant-facing team member on a NIDA-funded SBIR grant studying telehealth buprenorphine treatment across five high-risk settings: an Emergency Department, a correctional diversion program, a Tribal recovery community, a residential SUD treatment program, and a perinatal care program. This role manages all direct participant engagement — from recruitment and consent through longitudinal follow-up, stipend management, and qualitative interview support — as well as day-to-day data management in REDCap. The Research Associate reports to the Study Director and works closely with the Study Coordinator.

Patient Participant Recruitment, Follow-Up & Stipends - 50%

  • ​ Coordinate with site referral pipelines (managed by the Study Coordinator) to maintain rolling patient participant recruitment across all five sites
  • ​ Screen participants for eligibility and conduct informed consent via phone across all five sites
  • ​ Complete REDCap enrollment and baseline data entry for newly consented participants
  • ​ Conduct proactive follow-up outreach with enrolled participants at 4, 8, 12, and 16 weeks after enrollment for survey completion
  • ​ Administer phone-based assessments when web-based responses are not received
  • ​ Track follow-up completion rates by site and flag gaps to the Study Director
  • ​ Manage participant stipend disbursement via ClinCard at each assessment timepoint across all five sites; once the Study Coordinator has confirmed a ClinCard has been distributed to a participant by the site, the Research Associate loads funds and tracks disbursement
  • ​ Maintain participant-level contact logs and follow-up tracking records

Data Management - 30%

  • ​ Manage (and enter when needed) all participant data in REDCap with a high degree of accuracy
  • ​ Resolve edit queries and data discrepancies in a timely manner
  • ​ Prepare and submit data exports to UMass Chan Medical School (biostatistics partner) on schedule
  • ​ Conduct regular data quality checks in collaboration with Boulder’s Data Director
  • ​ Assist with scheduling participant qualitative interviews after 16-week follow-up completion; coordinate delivery of completed recordings to transcription vendor

Administrative Support - 20%

  • ​ Document and distribute notes from monthly site operations calls
  • ​ Draft administrative sections of NIDA progress reports (RPPRs) under the direction of the Study Director
  • ​ Support literature searches and reference management as needed
  • ​ Assist with preparation of interim data summaries and reports
  • ​ Provide general administrative support to the study team as needed

Qualifications

  • ​ Master’s degree in social work, public health, community health, psychology, or a related field
  • ​ 2+ years of direct experience working with people experiencing substance use disorder, homelessness, justice involvement, or other forms of structural marginalization — in a clinical, community health, peer support, or research context
  • ​ Strong interpersonal skills and ability to build rapport with participants in active, chaotic periods of their lives
  • ​ Persistence and comfort with high-volume outreach via phone and email, including engaging participants who are hard to reach or intermittently responsive
  • ​ Deep commitment to harm reduction and improving the health and dignity of people who use drugs
  • ​ Strong attention to detail and comfort with data entry and data management
  • ​ Comfort with remote work and virtual collaboration tools

Nice to Have

  • ​ Lived experience with substance use disorder or recovery (peer perspective valued)
  • ​ Experience working in a startup or fast-paced, high-growth environment
  • ​ Experience with REDCap or similar electronic data capture platforms
  • ​ Familiarity with IRB processes and Good Clinical Practice (GCP) principles
  • ​ Experience working across Tribal, correctional, perinatal, or ED settings
  • ​ Familiarity with ClinCard or other participant payment platforms
  • ​ Familiarity with NIH grant processes including progress reports (RPPRs)

Supervisory Responsibility

This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

Work Environment

This job operates in an office environment. May work in one of Boulder Care’s offices or remotely. Routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, and printers.

Physical Demands

This is a largely sedentary role; some job duties may require the ability to lift up to 10 pounds, bend and/or stand as necessary.

  • ​ Must be able to sit and/or stand for extended periods of time
  • ​ Able to look at a computer screen for extended periods of time to prepare and analyze data and information; transcribe information; and read

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work

This is a full-time, grant-funded position at 100% FTE, with guaranteed funding for a duration of two years. Team members may work with their managers to adjust work hours to suit the needs of the position, with a strong preference for Pacific working hours.

Travel

Approximately 5% travel is expected. Travel includes site visits to partner sites in Washington and Ohio to support study start-up, staff training, and ongoing participant engagement. Travel is planned and coordinated in advance; all travel costs are covered by the grant.

Compensation

The starting pay range for this position is $60,000-65,000k annually; base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including equity grants in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave).

Perks & Benefits

  • Contribute to meaningful, life-saving work!
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and short-term disability benefits designed to take care of our employees and their families
  • Mental Health Services via insurance coverage, including Talkspace and EAP for continuous care
    • Supplemental mental health services through Talkspace for care needed following tough patient visits
  • 4 weeks of vacation accrued per calendar year with a tenured increase to 5 weeks at 2 years of employment
  • Sick leave accrued at 1 hr for every 30 hrs paid
  • 9 Paid Holidays per year
  • 12 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for the birth or adoption of a child (after 6 months of employment)
  • 401(k) retirement savings
  • Remote friendly with hardware provided to complete your work duties

Our Values

  • The people we care for always come first
  • Our opportunity is also our duty, in service to others
  • Share facts to change minds, instill empathy to change hearts
  • Move the industry forward: follow the data
  • Strong individuals, stronger together
  • Boulder Care recognizes the value that lived experience can provide to our organization, community, and patients. Applicants with lived experience and/or training as a peer recovery specialist are encouraged to apply.

Hiring Process

30-minute Recruiter Phone Screen

45-minute Hiring Manager Video Interview

30-minute Executive Video Interview

As part of our hiring process, all final candidates will be required to undergo background checks and provide professional references. By applying, you acknowledge and consent to these checks, which may include employment history, criminal records, education/licensing verification, and professional references. We are committed to transparency and confidentiality throughout this process and will inform you in advance should any further information be required.

Please Note

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Back-end (LatAm)
description:
About Homeward

Homeward takes the “what ifs” out of homebuying by creating financial products that give buyers and sellers certainty and convenience. We’re a fast-paced, remote-first real estate startup that partners with real estate agents to offer innovative products and services, helping clients buy with cash, sell with certainty, and time their move, regardless of the market.

Founder and CEO Tim Heyl, owner of one of the fastest-growing agent teams in the country, started Homeward in 2018 to fix the antiquated and broken real estate process. Today, we offer bundled cash offers, mortgage, and title services in 13 states, enabling buyers and sellers to move with certainty and convenience.

We’re a fully remote company with a diverse team spread across several countries - Grounded in three core values: The Golden Rule, One Team One Dream, and Calm Focus. Hear from our employees about what our values mean to them.

About the opportunity

We're seeking a Senior Back-end Engineer to help us build a simpler, more customer-centric home buying and selling experience in partnership with real estate agents.

Due to current team needs, we are only accepting candidates based in Latin America. This is intended to be a long-term contract position.

In this role you will:

  • Develop, design, debug, and modify components of software applications and tools in agile environment
  • Write automated unit and integration tests as appropriate to support our continuous integration pipelines
  • Participate in code reviews to assess overall code quality and flexibility
  • Have a good understanding of Software Development Lifecycle and methodologies, specifically scrum and/or Kanban
  • Prototype creative solutions quickly by developing minimum viable products and work with seniors and peers in crafting and implementing the technical vision
  • Communicate and work effectively with distributed cross functional teams
  • Resolve problems and roadblocks as they occur with peers - follow through on details and drive issues to closure
  • Work towards continuous improvement in software and development process within an agile development team
  • Participate in user story creation in collaboration with the team
  • Leverage AI coding assistants and tools as a natural part of your daily development workflow — using them to accelerate prototyping, code review, debugging, and documentation
  • Design, build, and maintain AI-powered product features, including integrations with LLM APIs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and AI-driven automation

What you’ll bring:

  • 6+ years of non-internship, professional back-end development experience
  • Deep understanding of web development and best practices
  • Strong organizational skills and discipline in both following and appropriately challenging conventions
  • Skilled with common back-end technologies and patterns such as ReST API development, asynchronous task management, and databases / data management best practices.
  • Deep experience in one or more relevant back-end frameworks such as Django, Flask, or FastAPI
  • Experience working with Python
  • Scrappy determination and flexibility - from updating email templates to building complex web apps; you’re eager to learn and help the team succeed.
  • A build, test, learn mindset, with a bias toward quick, calculated action and a focus on business outcomes
  • Ability to rapidly prototype and adjust in response to customer feedback
  • Working knowledge of version control and CI/CD tools
  • Possess a high bar when it comes to quality - knowing when, what, and how to test
  • Hands-on experience with AI productivity tools (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, etc.)
  • Production experience with LLM APIs including prompt design and context management
  • General curiosity and comfort navigating the evolving AI landscape

Compensation:

  • Competitive hourly rate
  • Computer reimbursement

Value-Driven Employee Experience

THE GOLDEN RULE. It’s simple: Treat others the way we want to be treated. Whether we’re dealing with colleagues or customers, we don’t prioritize money or growth over people, and we practice empathy at every opportunity.

CALM FOCUS. We work in tech and build solutions for real estate. Both are fast-paced and stressful industries. But by focusing on the larger objective rather than rushing from one task to the next, we can create solutions our customers love.

ONE TEAM, ONE DREAM. Big problems require big solutions. We look at our customers’ experiences holistically and recognize that solving them requires collaboration across teams and our three affiliate companies — Homeward, Homeward Mortgage and Homeward Title.

title: Quality Engineer, Interior/ Exterior Trim
description:
About Harbinger

Harbinger is an American commercial electric vehicle (EV) company on a mission to transform an industry starving for innovation. Harbinger’s best-in-class team of EV, battery, and drivetrain experts have pooled their deep experience to bring a first-of-its-kind EV platform to support the growing demand for medium-duty EVs and Hybrids. Harbinger: Familiar Form, Revolutionary Foundation.

Job Overview

We are looking for a Quality Engineer to own Harbinger’s HC CAB interior and exterior quality. You will be responsible for ensuring the quality of our vehicle cabins, including interior and exterior trim and CAB components, throughout their life cycles. This role involves collaborating with suppliers, product designers, and production teams to establish and maintain quality standards, troubleshoot issues, and drive continuous improvement. This QE will act as a liaison between the company's cross-functional teams, our suppliers, and our customers. Responsibilities include defining quality standards, performing root cause analysis, defining inspection standards, equipment controls, quality gates, supplier selection, APQP, and determining corrective actions. A successful Cab Quality Engineer should have excellent analytic and troubleshooting skills and be able to ensure that processes and products are consistently improved.

What You’ll Do:

  • Monitor quality performance metrics, proactively identify and escalate emerging high-impact issues using supplier, internal process, and warranty data for early resolution.
  • Drive timely root cause analysis and resolution by engaging and holding cross-functional teams accountable with a data-driven approach.
  • Implement continuous improvement by driving lessons learned into relevant processes
  • Develop and track data-driven metrics for issue monitoring and corrective action effectiveness.
  • Create innovative tools and processes to enhance efficiency and scalability.
  • Continuously develop quality standards, quality control systems, and manufacturing and supplier quality protocols for Harbinger’s HC Series CAB.
  • Perform thorough inspection and testing of materials, equipment, processes, and products to ensure meticulous compliance with quality specifications.
  • Support the assembly team with equipment buyoff, conducting technical and statistical investigations concerning quality issues, methods, and equipment, culminating in actionable recommendations.
  • Formulate effective corrective actions, solutions, and enhancements for supplier, production, and product-related challenges specific to vehicle cabin systems.
  • Participate in design reviews alongside design engineering and manufacturing teams to mitigate manufacturing and assembly risks linked to cabin trim and interior components.
  • Lead and instruct interdisciplinary efforts to conduct root cause analysis for both internal and external cabin components, ensuring timely responses and validation of corrective actions to prevent non-conformances.
  • Lead MRB meetings and act as a quality representative within the engineering change control board for cabin and interior systems.

Who You Are:

  • You are a hands-on engineer that loves to solve problems.
  • You are bias for action and continuous improvement
  • You are energetic, passionate about quality and delivering best in class products
  • You have experience controlling class A surfaces (paint, interiors, etc..)
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Manufacturing) or a related technical field
  • Three to five years of pertinent experience in manufacturing quality or supplier quality engineering involving control of class A surfaces.
  • Proficiency in ISO-9001:2018 or IATF 16949 standards is highly desired
  • Familiarity with fundamental quality core tools including Quality Management Systems, Supplier and Internal Audits, APQP, SPC, PPAP, FMEA.
  • Excellent project management skills, capable of managing multiple projects concurrently
  • Solid understanding of paint quality, vehicle general assembly, EOL vehicle inspection advantageous
  • Ability to travel up to 30% of the time

Key Benefits & Perks:
  • Comprehensive Health, Dental & Vision (HDV) – 100% employee covered
  • Early-stage Stock Options
  • Robust Retirement Savings (401k, HSA, FSA)
  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) & Parental Leave
  • Annual Vacation Bonus
  • Wellness & Fertility Benefits
  • Cell Phone Stipend
  • Complimentary Meals & Stocked Kitchens

title: Supervisor
description:
Job Description: Admin Support

Position Title: Admin Support
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Minimum Qualification: Graduate (mandatory)

Role Overview:

The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.

This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Site Operations Oversight:

  • Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
  • Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
  • Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
  • Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
  • Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
  • Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
  • Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost & found registers.
  • Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
  • Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.

2. Technical Systems & Documentation:

  • Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
  • Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
  • Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
  • Take access approvals via eApproval portals.

3. Reporting & MIS:

  • Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
  • Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
  • Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.

4. Emergency & Incident Management:

  • Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
  • Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
  • Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
  • Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.

5. Client & Stakeholder Coordination:

  • Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
  • Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
  • Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
  • Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.

6. G4S Internal Coordination:

  • Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
  • Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
  • Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
  • Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.

Candidate Profile:

Minimum Requirements:

  • Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
  • Minimum 5–10 years of experience in security operations management
  • Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
  • Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.

Essential Competencies:

  • Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
  • Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
  • Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
  • Leadership & Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
  • Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

  • 100% compliance in daily deployment & reporting
  • ≥95% uptime for security equipment and systems
  • ≤2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
  • SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
  • Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores ≥90%

description:

The Secretary II Radiology reports to Unit Management. May schedule appointments, cases, and add-ons; may enter charges for services. Summary:

Electrolux is seeking a self‑driven, analytical, and highly influential professional to join the Reverse Logistics team as a Reverse Logistics Field Specialist. This role is responsible for leading the returns program and driving measurable performance improvements across key Reverse Logistics KPIs within our regional distribution center network. The Reverse Logistics Field Specialist serves as the subject matter expert for product handling and reverse processes, leveraging data, operational experience, and deep functional knowledge to deliver impactful training and guidance to both internal teams and external partners.

This role applies a strong combination of data analysis, process discipline, and creative problem‑solving to drive standardization, continuous improvement, damage and scrap reduction, and improved recovery rate outcomes. The position requires regular travel to regional distribution centers, carrier terminals, and customer locations to directly engage teams, assess execution, and influence behavior through hands‑on education and collaboration.

The ultimate purpose of this role is to reduce costs associated with damaged returns, improve recovery performance, and enhance customer experience through proactive engagement and expertise in reverse logistics and product handling.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Maintain safe work and travel practices at all times.
  • Own and analyze Reverse Logistics KPIs, identify trends, quantify impact, and drive corrective actions.
  • Manage travel schedules and conduct regular visits to regional distribution centers (RDCs), customer locations, and other sites for routine audits or follow-up on damage or return issues.
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with regional distribution centers and cross-functional business partners.
  • Serve as a escalation point for operational, quality, compliance, customer and system-related issues for the regional distribution centers
  • Partner with RDCs to develop and execute damage reduction, inventory optimization, and scrap reduction initiatives.
  • Review operational dashboards and audit findings to identify risks, gaps, and improvement opportunities.
  • Lead damage reduction efforts through data-driven analysis and collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Work with Quality teams to evaluate packaging design and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Provide ongoing training, coaching, and influence to RDC teams to reinforce best practices.
  • Identify, evaluate, and implement process improvement opportunities across Reverse Logistics operations.
  • Review and refine guidelines, processes, and policies to support standardization, efficiency, and simplification.
  • Foster a culture of inclusion, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree, required
  • EMS Green Gear Certification (or equivalent), preferred
  • Minimum 3 years relevant work experience in a supply chain role/function
  • Ability to travel

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required

  • Strong analytical rigor, including advanced root cause analysis, KPI development, dashboard interpretation, and the ability to translate trends into actionable insights.
  • Proven problem‑solving skills using critical thinking and data analytics.
  • Solid understanding of warehouse operations, material handling, packaging, transportation, and customer return flows.
  • Demonstrated passion for continuous improvement and driving operational change.
  • Ability to develop creative, compliant solutions for scratch‑and‑dent recovery and deliver measurable cost‑reduction results.
  • Strong influencing skills with the ability to build alignment across functions and channels with competing priorities.
  • Strong customer service mindset and effective internal/external stakeholder management.
  • Results‑oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and perform effectively in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, interpersonal skills, and the ability to build strong relationships with internal teams, customers, and key stakeholders.
  • Adaptable and flexible when faced with process changes, delays, or unexpected challenges.
  • Self‑motivated, dependable, energetic, and thorough.

Benefits

At Electrolux, we take responsibility for our development in a supportive environment where we embrace our differences and learn from each other. In a truly multicultural setting, we shape living for the better and create remarkable experiences for employees and consumers, all around the globe.

In 2023 Electrolux Group had sales of SEK 134 billion and employed 45,000 people around the world. For more information go to www.electroluxgroup.com.

title: ESG Quant Analyst - Stewardship Specialist
description:

title: Project Manager
description:
Job Summary

Industrial Power Solutions, a Sundt Company, is seeking an experienced Project Manager with a proven background in electrical construction. We specialize in water and wastewater, industrial, and process facility projects, delivering complete electrical construction solutions from preconstruction through project closeout. This position is responsible for leading projects from award to completion by managing budgets, schedules, subcontractors, procurement, field operations, and client relationships while ensuring the highest standards of safety, quality, and financial performance.

The ideal candidate has experience managing industrial electrical construction projects, excels at coordinating with field leadership and customers, and is committed to delivering successful projects on time and within budget.

Key Responsibilities

Project Leadership and Execution

• Manage all phases of electrical construction projects from award through completion.
• Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, forecasts, and execution plans.
• Coordinate project resources to ensure safe, efficient, and successful project delivery.
• Lead project kickoff meetings and establish project objectives, milestones, and expectations.

Financial Management

• Manage project budgets, cost tracking, forecasting, and financial reporting.
• Review and approve project costs, commitments, and subcontractor expenditures.
• Identify and manage project risks, change orders, and cost impacts.
• Support monthly financial reviews and ensure project profitability goals are achieved.

Client and Stakeholder Management

• Serve as the primary point of contact for owners, general contractors, engineers, and project stakeholders.
• Develop and maintain strong customer relationships throughout the project lifecycle.
• Lead project meetings and provide regular updates regarding schedule, budget, and project status.
• Resolve project issues and conflicts in a professional and timely manner.

Schedule and Construction Coordination

• Work closely with field leadership to support schedule execution and project milestones.
• Coordinate procurement, material deliveries, subcontractors, and project resources.
• Monitor project progress and proactively identify opportunities to improve performance.
• Support short interval planning and overall project execution strategies.

Safety and Quality

• Promote and support a culture of safety across all project activities.
• Ensure compliance with company safety policies and project requirements.
• Support quality control initiatives and ensure work is completed in accordance with project specifications and customer expectations.
• Participate in project audits, safety reviews, and quality assessments.

Contract Administration

• Review and manage contracts, subcontracts, purchase orders, and project documentation.
• Manage change orders, requests for information, and project correspondence.
• Ensure proper project documentation is maintained throughout the project lifecycle.
• Support project closeout activities including turnover documentation and final reporting.

Leadership and Team Development

• Provide leadership and support to Superintendents, field teams, and project staff.
• Foster a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing project culture.
• Mentor and develop team members while supporting long-term organizational growth.
• Promote continuous improvement and best practices across project operations.

Minimum Job Requirements


• Minimum 5 years of Project Management experience on large-scale electrical construction projects.
• Strong understanding of electrical systems including switchgear, generators, power distribution, grounding, and electrical infrastructure.
• Experience managing project budgets, schedules, forecasting, and contract administration.
• Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, contracts, and project schedules.
• Strong leadership, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite including Excel, Word, Outlook, and Project.
• Valid driver's license required with acceptable driving record.
• Ability to pass pre-employment drug screening and background check.
• Ability and willingness to travel nationwide for extended project assignments.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with Procore, Bluebeam, Primavera P6, or similar project management software.
• Experience managing projects exceeding $20 million in electrical contract value.

Note: Job Description is subject to change at any time and may include other duties as assigned.

Physical Requirements

• Work may be performed in office and active construction environments.
• Ability to walk construction sites, climb ladders, and access active work areas.
• Ability to stand for extended periods during project visits and meetings.
• Required to wear personal protective equipment while visiting job sites.
• Extensive travel to project locations nationwide is required.

Safety Level

Safety Sensitive

Note: Jobs with the Safety Sensitive designation include tasks that may affect the safety and health of the employee or others such as supporting construction operations and working in active industrial environments.

As a 100% employee-owned contractor, when you work at Industrial Power Solutions, a Sundt Company, you are not just joining a company, you are joining a culture. Because every employee is an owner, our team is deeply invested in the quality of the work we perform. Skills

  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with all employees

We can't wait to meet you.

title: Civil Engineering Project Coordinator
description:
As a Project Coordinator within the Civil Engineering & Construction Department, you will support the planning, execution, and delivery of civil infrastructure, site development, and construction projects. Working closely with Senior Project Managers, consultants, contractors, and regulatory agencies, you will help ensure projects are completed safely, efficiently, on schedule, and within budget.

What You Will Be Responsible For

  • Assist in gathering project requirements and preparing project initiation documents, project charters, and detailed scopes of work.
  • Develop, maintain, and update project schedules using Microsoft Project (MS Project).
  • Prepare construction cost estimates, budget forecasts, quantity take-offs, and project cost analyses for capital and infrastructure projects.
  • Prepare conceptual, preliminary, and detailed civil construction cost estimates; review contractor quotations; perform bid analyses; and provide recommendations to support project budgeting and procurement decisions.
  • Prepare tender packages, bid requests, Requests for Quotation (RFQs), and scopes of work for civil engineering and construction projects.
  • Source, evaluate, and coordinate consultants, contractors, suppliers, surveyors, geotechnical engineers, and other service providers.
  • Coordinate procurement activities, including material purchasing, contractor tendering, bid evaluations, and contract administration.
  • Support municipal, provincial, conservation authority, and other regulatory approval and permitting processes.
  • Coordinate with municipalities, regulatory agencies, utility providers, and approval authorities to obtain project approvals and permits.
  • Conduct site visits, inspections, and construction progress reviews while providing regular project status updates to the Engineering Manager.
  • Review contractor performance, identify project risks, and assist in resolving technical, operational, and scheduling issues.
  • Monitor project execution to ensure compliance with health and safety regulations, environmental requirements, engineering standards, and company policies.
  • Support project budgeting, cost tracking, forecasting, change management, and project controls.
  • Coordinate project meetings, maintain project documentation, and prepare weekly and monthly progress reports.
  • Review engineering drawings, reports, specifications, tender documents, grading plans, stormwater management reports, and site servicing designs.
  • Assist with contract administration activities, including RFIs, change orders, submittals, field reviews, and project closeout documentation.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders, operations personnel, and external consultants to ensure successful project delivery.
  • Assist in reviewing topographic surveys, utility information, and existing site conditions to support project development.
  • Prepare and update project documentation using AutoCAD, and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Create purchase orders and service requests using IBM Maximo.
  • Travel to AIM facilities and project sites across Canada and the United States, as required.
  • Advanced Diploma or bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, Civil Engineering Technology, Construction Management, or a related field.
  • 1–3 years of experience in civil engineering, site development, infrastructure, land development, or construction projects.
  • Co-op or internship experience will be considered.
  • Experience coordinating consultants, contractors, and regulatory agencies is an asset.
  • Valid Class G Driver's License with a clean driving record.

Skills & Competencies

  • Basic understanding of civil engineering principles, site development, grading, drainage, stormwater management, underground servicing, and construction practices.
  • Knowledge of project management principles, construction practices, and contractor coordination.
  • Strong organizational, multitasking, and time-management skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, reports, and contract documents.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Microsoft Project, and AutoCAD.

  • Knowledge of health and safety regulations within construction and industrial environments.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Willingness and ability to travel, including occasional travel to the United States.

title: X-Ray Technologist - Full Time
description:
Overview

Our team members are the heart of what makes us better. At Hackensack Meridian Health we help our patients live better, healthier lives — and we help one another to succeed. With a culture rooted in connection and collaboration, our employees are team members. Here, competitive benefits are just the beginning. It’s also about how we support one another and how we show up for our community. Together, we keep getting better - advancing our mission to transform healthcare and serve as a leader of positive change.

The X-ray Technologist is responsible for obtaining diagnostic radiographic examinations.

Responsibilities

A day in the life of a Radiology Technologist at Hackensack Meridian Health includes:

  • Produces diagnostic radiographic examinations by positioning patients, providing immobilization devices, shielding, selecting proper technical factors based on individual patient needs. Select and operate equipment as required for specific procedures.
  • Uses consistent and appropriate techniques to gather relevant information from the medical record, significant others and health care providers to prepare protocols for scanning and patient safety. The collection of information is determined by the patient's needs or condition.
  • In accordance with ALARA principles restricts radiation beam through proper & safe collimation, providing safe care to all patients.
  • Performs portable x-ray examinations in patient rooms, operating rooms, and emergency rooms.
  • Follows operational procedure to safely identify patient's images with name and MRN#, correctly mark the image as to the side of the patient taken.
  • Processes & reconstructs all images using methods available.
  • Maintains orderly x-ray room, including ordering and maintaining proper & adequate supplies as directed by head of the department.
  • Prepares radiopaque contrast media and assists providers when necessary in administering radiopaque mixtures to patients.
  • Performs administrative duties related to scheduling appointments, patient's instruction, maintenance of records, reception of patients and other administrative duties as required.
  • Renders services and/or assistance to all patients depending on the individual patient's needs and abilities in moving, turning, getting on and off the x-ray tables, etc.
  • Responsible for scheduled shifts including holidays and weekends.
  • Overtime as needed to provide continual quality patient care.
  • On call assignments as needed per Department of Radiology policy.
  • Adheres to the policies of Employee ID, Standards of Behavior, Attendance, and Punctuality.
  • Greets all patients when they arrive for their exam utilizing A.I.D.E.T. standards.
  • Performs daily clerical duties, which includes the use of EPIC, PACS, Teletracking System, computer system, patient scheduling, and other computer systems as added by hospital.
  • Identifies the needs of the patient population served and modifies and delivers care that is specific to those needs (i.e., age, culture, language, hearing and/or visually impaired, etc.). This process includes communicating with the patient, parent, and/or primary caregiver(s) at their level (developmental/age, educational, literacy, etc.).
  • Adheres to the standards identified in the Medical Center's Organizational Competencies.
  • Performs specific daily and monthly QA.
  • Other duties and/or projects as assigned.
  • Adheres to HMH Organizational competencies and standards of behavior.
  • Lifts a minimum of 25 lbs., pushes and pulls a minimum of 50 lbs. and stands a minimum of 6 hours a day.

Qualifications

Education, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required:

  • High School diploma, general equivalency diploma (GED), and/or GED equivalent programs.
  • Completion of an AMA approved school of Radiologic Technology.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficient computer skills that may include but are not limited to Microsoft Office and/or Google Suite platforms.

Licenses and Certifications Required:

  • American Registry of Radiologic Technologists Certification
  • NJ state license for Diagnostic Radiology (D.R.)
  • AHA Basic Health Care Life Support HCP Certification within 60 days of entering position

If you feel the above description speaks directly to your strengths and capabilities, then please apply today!

Starting Minimum Rate

Minimum rate of $38.27 Hourly

Job Posting Disclosure

HMH is committed to pay equity and transparency for our team members. The posted rate of pay in this job posting is a reasonable good faith estimate of the minimum base pay for this role at the time of posting in accordance with the New Jersey Pay Transparency Act and does not reflect the full value of our market-competitive total rewards package. Education and Certifications: Level of education attained, including specialized certifications, credentials, completed apprenticeship programs or advanced training. Skills: Demonstrated proficiency in relevant skills and competencies. Geographic Location: Cost of living and market rates for the specific location. Internal Equity: Compensation is determined in a manner consistent with compensation ranges for similar roles within the organization. Budget and Grant Funding: Departmental budgets and any grant funding associated with the job position may impact the pay that can be offered. Briotix Health is seeking a full-time Industrial Sports Medicine Professional!

Position Overview:

The Industrial Sports Medicine Professional is responsible for providing onsite care to the working athletes we serve by being the expert in job function and technical task analysis, maintaining a thorough understanding of functional body movements, discomforts, and following established OSHA First Aid standards and guidelines.

This position is an integral part of the Industrial Sports Medicine Service line and will collaborate with other Briotix Health key stakeholders. The goals of the position are to develop strong relationships, provide injury prevention & early discomfort management (EDM) programs, and assist in providing ergonomic solutions to Briotix Health’s clients.

While we must meet our contractual client expectations, Briotix Health values work/life balance. If you thrive in a people-focused environment and are great at working autonomously, you could be a terrific fit for this role.

  • Provide education & training for individuals and groups focused on injury and illness prevention.
  • Provide onsite care and management of work and non-work-related discomforts.

  • Education in Athletic Training, Kinesiology, Exercise Physiology, Physical Therapy, Occupational Therapy, or related field.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world’s first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences.

As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results.

Senior Data Analyst

Location: Weybridge, Surrey, United Kingdom

Established in 2004, Inside Ideas Group is a rapidly growing global agency network that helps clients drive their businesses forward from the inside. We partner with over 300 clients in more than 40 countries, delivering ideas, technology and creativity that make a measurable impact.

As part of The Brandtech Group, we are pioneers in using advanced AI technologies to transform the way we create, optimise and deliver work. Our AI capabilities enhance efficiency, support smart decision making and unlock new levels of creativity for our teams and clients.

We are now looking for a skilled Data Analyst to join our onsite team supporting in London.

About the Role

As the Data Analyst, you will be responsible for delivering insight that drives improvements across the full commercial ecosystem spanning customer experience on, retailer investment effectiveness, marketing and sales performance, and the broader post-purchase, onboarding and promotional landscape.

A core part of your remit will be the design, build and ongoing management of a marketing and sales performance dashboard, underpinned by Google BigQuery and delivered in Looker Studio. This will serve as a critical decision-making tool for marketing, e-commerce, retail and CX teams surfacing insight such as campaign uplift, halo effects, retailer investment impact and share performance across products and markets.

Alongside this, you will analyse customer journeys, benchmark competitors, oversee content performance and support the planning and execution of onboarding and e-commerce promotions using platforms like GWI to create digital personas and audience profiles.

You will collaborate closely with CX, marketing, product and e-commerce teams as well as HQ and local market stakeholders to ensure insight informs decisions at every stage.

This role requires strong analytical capability, expertise in data modelling and SQL, and the ability to translate complex commercial questions into dashboard logic and actionable recommendations.

What You Will Be Doing

Marketing & Sales Performance Analytics

  • Design, build and maintain a marketing and sales performance dashboard in Looker Studio, underpinned by BigQuery, combining sell-out sales data, market volume and share data, and campaign activity logs.
  • Define the underlying data model, transform source files and design the reporting layer to support consistent, scalable KPI delivery.
  • Identify and quantify the impact of retailer investment, including uplift in sales and market share during campaign periods.
  • Analyse correlations between campaign activity and commercial performance to determine which marketing levers are most effective.
  • Measure and report on halo effects across products and retailers resulting from promotional and campaign activity.
  • Define and calculate key performance metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects.
  • Work with GFK or other syndicated market data sources to enrich performance analysis with market volume and share context.

Customer Experience & Digital Analytics

  • Conduct analysis of the current customer experience, including user behaviour, content and campaign performance and conversion pathways.
  • Benchmark key customer journeys against competitor websites to identify gaps and opportunities.
  • Provide regular insight into paid promotions, post-purchase experience and customer satisfaction trends.
  • Support planning, optimisation and operational management of post-purchase and onboarding experience.
  • Analyse content utilisation, engagement and drop-off points, and recommend enhancements.
  • Collaborate with HQ and local teams on onboarding content production and implementation.
  • Support feature management including evaluation, testing performance and monitoring adoption, with ongoing analysis of content effectiveness and customer experience updates.
  • Reporting, Dashboards & Stakeholder Insight
  • Build and maintain dashboards, reports and ad hoc analyses across customer experience, onboarding, e-commerce, retail performance and promotion activity.
  • Translate data into clear insights that guide decision-making within marketing, CX, digital and commercial teams.
  • Present findings clearly to stakeholders at all levels, ensuring insight is embedded in planning and operational processes.
  • Use platforms like GWI to build digital personas and audience profiles that support broader marketing planning.

What You Need to Be Great in This Role

Essential

  • Proven experience as a data or insight analyst within digital, e-commerce, retail, marketing or agency environments.
  • Strong proficiency in Google BigQuery and advanced SQL, including data modelling and reporting layer design.
  • Hands-on experience building dashboards in Looker Studio, with a clear understanding of how to structure underlying data models for robust, scalable dashboard performance.
  • Demonstrable experience combining sell-out sales, market share and campaign activity datasets to generate commercial insight.
  • Ability to define and calculate metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects.
  • Strong marketing analytics capability, including campaign effectiveness measurement across paid and promotional channels.
  • Good understanding of digital customer journeys, content performance metrics and e-commerce KPIs.
  • Experience with analytics platforms such as Google Analytics GA4, Adobe Analytics or similar.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling ability — capable of translating complex business questions into dashboard logic and presenting findings clearly to non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working with multi-market teams and managing stakeholder expectations across business functions.
  • A passion for data-driven decision-making and an interest in how AI can enhance analytics workflows.

Preferred:

  • Proficiency in Python (pandas) for data transformation, automation and workflow scripting.
  • Broader experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including automating data ingestion and transformation workflows.
  • Experience working in retail, e-commerce or retailer media environments.
  • Familiarity with GfK or other syndicated market data sources.
  • Experience with additional BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI.

Position Summary:

The CCTV Operator is responsible for operating and monitoring surveillance systems to safeguard people, property, and infrastructure at client locations across South India. This role involves real-time monitoring, incident detection, reporting, and supporting emergency response through CCTV systems, access control integration, and event logging.

Key Responsibilities:

1. CCTV Surveillance Monitoring:

  • Monitor multiple live camera feeds in real-time from control rooms across various zones.

  • Respond swiftly to unusual or abnormal activity, including intrusion, fire alarms, loitering, or unauthorized access.

  • Assist site teams during live incidents by guiding them using visual monitoring.

3. Access Control Support:

  • Monitor and verify access control events if CCTV is integrated with turnstiles, boom barriers, or biometric systems.
  • Cross-check identity and authorization of personnel or vehicles as per client SOPs.
  • Flag tailgating, force entries, or violation of visitor movement policy.

  • Retrieve historical footage upon request from the client or internal G4S supervisors.

  • Conduct regular checks on all CCTV equipment including cameras, DVR/NVRs, monitors, switches, and power backups.
  • Coordinate with the technical support team or client vendor for maintenance, servicing, or repairs.
  • Report any malfunctioning cameras or broken connections immediately.

6. Reporting & Documentation:

  • Maintain daily control room logs, shift handover notes, and incident records.

title: Asset Management - Private Markets Portfolio Risk and Liquidity - Vice President
description:
Description:
The Multi Asset Private Markets Investment Team, a part of Global Alternative Investment Solutions (GAIS) within JPMorganChase & Co’s Asset & Wealth Management division, is responsible for sourcing, underwriting, and managing portfolios of private investment funds and co-investments. Strategies span the private investment universe, including buyout, growth equity, venture capital, private credit, real estate, and infrastructure. Based in New York with offices in London and Mumbai, the team has underwritten and onboarded 300+ funds representing over $175 billion in client commitments.

Job Summary:
As a core member of our portfolio management team leading our risk and liquidity analysis for our managed evergreen investment programs. You will help lead our internal risk considerations for our investment committee. In partnership with our portfolio managers, you will be responsible for ensuring that registered ’40 Act funds maintain adequate liquidity to support regulatory and redemption obligations. Your role will involve stress-testing liquidity models and analyzing the optimal mix, allocation, and timing of liquidity tiers to determine the most efficient approach to fulfilling capital needs while minimizing cash drag. You will have the opportunity to work closely with senior research leads, portfolio managers, and operational partners.

Job responsibilities:

  • Build and own forward-looking liquidity models (subscriptions/redemptions, distributions, capital calls, unfunded commitments) and provide clear 30/60/90-day triggers to PMs on sizing liquidity sleeves
  • Lead ’40 Act liquidity oversight for the platform, partnering with risk and compliance teams, to ensure vehicles remain continuously compliant without over-allocating to idle cash
  • Assist in the oversight and management of debt providers
  • Support our Investment Committee in the risk evaluation of new investments
  • Optimize liquidity sleeves and cash deployment, including solutions for investing cash held against unfunded commitments and guidance on deploying excess cash consistent with constraints
  • Coordinate a unified liquidity view across PMs, Trading, CFO/Treasury partners, and administrators

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

  • 5+ years of full-time relevant work experience in asset management and/or private investments with a focus on risk and liquidity management
  • Strong data and analytical skills
  • Strong understanding of ’40 Act evergreen funds and knowledge of corresponding international evergreen fund requirements
  • Demonstrated experience building predictive cash-flow/liquidity forecasting models for multi-vehicle portfolios
  • Detail-oriented and process-driven
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Strategic and team-oriented mindset

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

  • Experience structuring/negotiating fund financing facilities and implementing them operationally (covenants, monitoring, reporting)
  • Experience applying AI/ML tools to forecasting, anomaly detection, or workflow automation in a controlled environment (model documentation, testing, and stakeholder sign-off).
  • SICAV Part II, preferred
