title: FIREMAN
description:
Job Title: Fireman

Department: Fire & Safety / Security Operations
Location: Client Premises (Pan-India deployment)
Reporting To: Fire & Safety Officer / Site In-charge / Security Manager

Objective of the Role:

To ensure immediate and effective response to fire and emergency situations at the client premises, assist in the prevention of fire hazards, and support the client’s overall safety and security operations through regular inspections, drills, and fire safety compliance.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Fire Prevention and Risk Mitigation

  • Conduct routine fire safety inspections across the premises, especially high-risk areas.
  • Identify and report fire hazards, unsafe practices, and recommend corrective actions.
  • Ensure proper storage and usage of flammable materials as per safety guidelines.
  • Check availability, functionality, and accessibility of fire extinguishers, hydrants, hoses, sprinklers, alarms, smoke detectors, and emergency lights.

2. Fire Response and Emergency Handling

  • Respond promptly to fire alarms and emergency calls.
  • Operate firefighting equipment such as fire extinguishers, hose reels, hydrants, foam, and breathing apparatus.
  • Evacuate personnel from affected areas and guide them to safe assembly zones.
  • Administer first-aid and support paramedical teams during emergencies.
  • Assist the firefighting team, civil authorities, and local fire brigade in containment and post-incident recovery.

3. Compliance and Documentation

  • Maintain detailed incident logs and fire safety inspection records.
  • Assist in ensuring compliance with local Fire Safety Norms, NBC (National Building Code), and client-specific fire regulations.
  • Support internal audits and third-party fire inspections.

4. Training & Drills

  • Conduct or participate in fire drills, evacuation exercises, and mock emergency simulations.
  • Educate on-site personnel on fire safety protocols and emergency procedures.
  • Provide demonstrations on the usage of fire safety equipment.

5. Maintenance & Housekeeping

  • Inspect fire equipment daily and maintain logs for servicing schedules.
  • Ensure that escape routes, fire exits, and emergency doors are not blocked.
  • Liaise with facility teams for maintenance of fire panels, sprinklers, pumps, and water tanks.

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Education: Minimum 10th Pass. Diploma or Certificate in Fire Safety or Industrial Firefighting from a recognized institute is mandatory.
  • Preferred Certifications:
    • Fireman Training from State Fire Services / Civil Defence / Government-recognized institutes
    • Basic First Aid and CPR Certification
  • Experience: 2–5 years in industrial, commercial, or institutional firefighting roles. Freshers with formal fireman training can also be considered.

Skills & Competencies Required:

  • Thorough knowledge of fire detection and suppression systems.
  • Ability to work calmly under pressure and respond quickly in emergencies.
  • Physically fit, alert, and able to carry firefighting equipment.
  • Clear communication skills and basic understanding of Hindi/English/regional language.
  • Team player with a disciplined and responsible attitude.

Work Environment & Physical Requirements:

  • Rotational shifts (day/night) including weekends and holidays.
  • High-risk environment requiring PPE usage.
  • Need to remain alert and mobile throughout the shift.
  • May require climbing, lifting, and operating in confined or high areas during fire events.

Employment Terms:

  • Employer: G4S Secure Solutions India Pvt. Ltd.
  • Deployment: At client’s site (industrial, corporate, hospital, mall, warehouse, etc.)
  • Uniform & Equipment: Provided by G4S
  • Remuneration: As per industry standards and location norms
  • Contract Type: Full-Time / Contractual based on client agreement

Growth Path:

  • Fireman → Senior Fireman → Fire & Safety Supervisor → Fire & Safety Officer → Fire Safety Manager

Additional Notes:

  • Background verification and medical fitness check are mandatory prior to deployment.
  • Strict adherence to G4S Code of Conduct and client site rules is expected at all times.

title: Director of Engineering, Data
description:
At BuildOps, we build software for modern commercial contractors, from service management through project delivery. We care deeply about the mission and look for people who are driven, self motivated, and excited by fast moving, high ownership environments.

Data sits at the center of BuildOps' AI first strategy. The operational data our customers generate on BuildOps is a long term advantage, but only if it is clean, reliable, and well governed. As Director of Engineering, Data, you will build and lead our unified Data & AI engineering function. You will own the platforms, pipelines, quality standards, and operating discipline that power AI and ML products and help customers trust BuildOps as their system of record.

Reporting to the VP of Engineering, you will help define BuildOps' data strategy over the next three to five years and shape how we build data powered products. This is a foundational leadership role for someone who can think long term about architecture while staying close to the work. You have built and scaled data organizations before and know how to take a team from early stage scrappiness to operational excellence.

What You'll Do

  • Own BuildOps' data platform and architecture end to end, including ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and an ML and streaming strategy that evolves with the business and scales efficiently
  • Build scalable, repeatable customer and partner data onboarding capabilities that bring data into BuildOps quickly and reliably, reducing time to first value
  • Run data systems with production grade discipline, including monitoring, alerting, SLAs, incident response, lineage, freshness, and clear ownership for critical datasets
  • Create the data foundation required for AI and ML products, with accurate, well documented inputs today and the right training, inference, and feature infrastructure as those products mature
  • Establish governance that supports speed, including access controls, data classification, audit trails, PII handling, and practical data contracts that teams can depend on
  • Hire, develop, and lead a strong data engineering team, and establish the right operating rhythms across planning, on call, and stakeholder intake

What We Look For

  • 10+ years in data or software engineering, including experience building and scaling teams of 10+ engineers, with a track record of hiring well, growing leaders, and leading through managers as well as individual contributors
  • Deep hands on experience with modern data platforms, including a cloud warehouse or lakehouse such as Snowflake or Databricks, dbt and ELT patterns, orchestration tools like Airflow, and streaming technologies such as Kafka or Kinesis, with AWS experience strongly preferred
  • Direct experience building data systems that support production ML use cases, not just analytics, with an understanding of feature stores, training data, real time inference, and the tradeoffs involved in building versus buying ML platform capabilities
  • A track record of operational excellence in data, including monitoring, SLAs, incident response, and data quality practices applied with the same rigor as customer facing systems
  • Experience delivering customer facing data products such as reporting, analytics, or APIs in B2B SaaS environments where performance, reliability, and trust matter
  • Strong architectural judgment, including when to build, when to buy, how to design for change, and how to sequence investments behind validated needs instead of overbuilding
  • A pragmatic approach to governance, with security and compliance built in, documentation and contracts that stay current, and access models that balance control with self service
  • Early stage or scale up experience in Series B through D companies is a plus, and experience in vertical SaaS or construction tech is helpful but not required

Who You Are

  • A builder who is comfortable with ambiguity and greenfield work, and can move quickly, ship an MVP, and still make sound decisions for long term scale
  • Both hands on and strategic, willing to write code, debug issues, and carry operational responsibility when needed while maintaining a clear multi year vision
  • You know how to influence across Product, Engineering, GTM, Finance, and the executive team, build trust, communicate clearly, and push back when priorities are misaligned
  • Able to translate technical decisions into business impact and business goals into technical direction
  • You have seen this stage of growth before and know what good looks like in a high growth data organization

Compensation

  • $203,000 - $271,000 base salary range + annual bonus + meaningful equity
What we offer:
  • Generous equity grant, become an owner in our company!
  • A comprehensive benefits package
  • Flexible PTO and hybrid work schedules
  • One-time work-from-home allowance
  • Hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, Toronto, and Raleigh with hybrid work schedules and lunch provided for in-office days
  • Company events and team-building activities, both in-person and virtual
  • Fast-paced, collaborative, and dynamic work environment
  • Opportunities for growth and career advancement
  • Chance to work with cutting-edge technology and innovative solutions
  • The chance to get in on the ground floor and build something truly groundbreaking for ourselves and our amazing customers

title: Supervisor
description:
Job Description: Admin Support

Position Title: Admin Support
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Minimum Qualification: Graduate (mandatory)

Role Overview:

The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.

This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Site Operations Oversight:

  • Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
  • Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
  • Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
  • Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
  • Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
  • Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
  • Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost & found registers.
  • Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
  • Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.

2. Technical Systems & Documentation:

  • Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
  • Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
  • Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
  • Take access approvals via eApproval portals.

3. Reporting & MIS:

  • Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
  • Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
  • Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.

4. Emergency & Incident Management:

  • Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
  • Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
  • Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
  • Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.

5. Client & Stakeholder Coordination:

  • Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
  • Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
  • Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
  • Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.

6. G4S Internal Coordination:

  • Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
  • Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
  • Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
  • Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.

Candidate Profile:

Minimum Requirements:

  • Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
  • Minimum 5–10 years of experience in security operations management
  • Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
  • Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.

Essential Competencies:

  • Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
  • Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
  • Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
  • Leadership & Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
  • Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

  • 100% compliance in daily deployment & reporting
  • ≥95% uptime for security equipment and systems
  • ≤2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
  • SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
  • Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores ≥90%

title: Program Manager
description:
We're reimagining the way Australians live, work, and play. We own and manage some of the most recognisable and loved retail destinations across Australia.


We’re evolving our portfolio into destinations that offer a broad selection of retail, residential, and office spaces. Through our diverse portfolio, data-led decision-making, and nationwide development pipeline, we do things differently.

We are Vicinity.

Role purpose

Program Manager (12-Month Fixed Term Contract)

Lead a business-critical modernisation program and help shape the future of our organisation

We are seeking an experienced Program Manager to play a pivotal role in the mobilisation and delivery planning of a major enterprise-wide modernisation program. Reporting into the Enterprise Delivery & Governance team, this highly visible role will partner closely with business leaders, technology teams, and program sponsors to establish the foundations for a successful transformation initiative.

This is an opportunity for a strong communicator and relationship builder who can confidently operate across both business and technology environments, translating complex concepts into clear, concise and actionable insights for a broad range of stakeholders, including executive leadership.

About the Role

As Program Manager, you will lead the mobilisation phase of a significant modernisation program, driving planning, governance, business case development, stakeholder alignment and delivery readiness. You will work across multiple business functions and technology teams to ensure priorities, dependencies and outcomes are clearly understood and effectively managed.

Success in this role will require someone who can balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution, confidently facilitate discussions, and provide objective, executive-ready reporting on progress, risks, decisions and program outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the mobilisation and planning of a large-scale enterprise modernisation program.

  • Develop and maintain the program roadmap, delivery approach and implementation plans.

  • Drive business case development, solution evaluation and requirements gathering activities.

  • Establish governance frameworks, reporting structures and delivery controls.

  • Prepare clear, concise and executive-ready updates for steering committees and senior leadership forums.

  • Build strong relationships across business, technology and external stakeholders to drive alignment and outcomes.

  • Facilitate workshops, planning sessions and decision-making forums.

  • Identify, manage and communicate program risks, issues and dependencies.

  • Coordinate activities across multiple workstreams to support delivery readiness and successful execution.

About You

You are a collaborative and influential Program Manager with a track record of leading complex business and technology-enabled initiatives. While you understand technology delivery practices and system implementation lifecycles, your true strength lies in your ability to bring people together, navigate complexity and communicate effectively at all levels of an organisation.

You will bring:

  • Proven experience leading complex transformation, modernisation or enterprise-wide programs.

  • Strong communication, stakeholder engagement and facilitation skills.

  • Ability to engage, influence and build credibility with senior leaders, business stakeholders and technology teams.

  • Experience developing business cases, governance frameworks and delivery roadmaps.

  • Strong governance, reporting and program management capability.

  • Experience working across Agile, Waterfall or hybrid delivery environments.

  • Sound understanding of technology delivery, implementation methodologies and ways of working.

  • Ability to distil complex information into meaningful insights and executive-level communications.

  • Demonstrated experience managing competing priorities, risks, dependencies and stakeholder expectations.

Why Join Us?

This is a rare opportunity to play a key role in a high-profile transformation initiative that will have broad organisational impact. You will work alongside experienced business and technology leaders, influence strategic outcomes and help shape the future direction of a major enterprise program.

The initial appointment is for 12 months, with the potential for ongoing involvement in future delivery phases, subject to program requirements and funding approval.

If you're an experienced Program Manager who thrives at the intersection of business strategy, stakeholder engagement and technology delivery, we'd love to hear from you.

Why Vicinity?

Our benefits program focuses on creating an awesome place to work in which our people are rewarded and recognised. This includes:

  • Flexible working options

  • Birthday leave & purchased additional leave

  • $1,000 worth of VCX securities rewarded for eligible team members

We live and work by our values of Respect, Integrity, Customer Focus, Collaboration and Excellence. They are the foundation to everything we do and provide us a north star with which we can shape meaningful places where communities connect.

At Vicinity we embrace and celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive work environment where we attract, retain and develop our people regardless of gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability and age. title: Staff Development Coordinator
description:
Staff Development Coordinator RN – Trinity Oaks Health & Rehab

Position Overview

Trinity Oaks Health & Rehab is seeking a full-time Staff Development Coordinator RN. This position offers a Monday–Friday schedule, with pay discussed during the interview. Benefit eligibility begins after 30 days and includes insurance coverage and PTO. Team members who opt out of benefits receive an additional $2.00 per hour.

In this role, the Staff Development Coordinator organizes facility-wide in-service and training programs, supports electronic medical record system education, and helps ensure staff remain current with required education. The SDC may also assist with Infection Prevention Coordinator responsibilities and support the Quality Assurance and Performance Improvement Program (QAPI).

Essential Duties

The Staff Development Coordinator works in accordance with federal and state regulations, as well as Lutheran Services Carolinas guidelines, to support staff education, compliance, quality improvement, and safe facility operations.

  • Maintain the monthly required in-service calendar and assign online or supplemental training as needed.
  • Lead orientation for new staff, complete skills assessments, and recommend additional training when appropriate.
  • Coordinate education and training for the electronic medical record system.
  • Maintain staff education records and notify supervisors when requirements have not been met.
  • Assess facility-wide training needs, develop programs with department managers, and support individual staff development.
  • Provide targeted coaching for staff who need improvement or additional support.
  • Collect quality assurance data and assist with QAPI coordination under administrative direction.
  • Attend QAPI meetings, review data, identify opportunities for improvement, and help implement solutions.
  • Evaluate training programs using staff feedback and recommend updates as needed.
  • Bring in outside consultants and community resources to enhance learning opportunities.
  • Train staff on new and updated policies and procedures.
  • Support infection prevention efforts as directed, including maintaining infection control programs, tracking infections, assisting with investigations, and overseeing vaccination campaigns.
  • Ensure Hepatitis B vaccines are offered, maintain related documentation, and verify TB clearance for new employees.
  • Oversee drug testing for new hires and coordinate random screenings.
  • Confirm required CPR training for personnel.
  • Perform on-call nursing duties when assigned.
  • Represent LSC’s mission, vision, values, and service standards in daily interactions.
  • Complete other duties necessary to support effective facility operations.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This role does not routinely include direct supervision, except when serving as nursing supervisor or charge nurse.

Qualifications

  • Education: Graduate of an accredited nursing school.
  • Experience: Minimum of one year of nursing experience.
  • Licensure: Current Registered Nurse license in North Carolina.

Preferred Qualifications

Preferred qualifications include a BSN degree, eligibility for CPR and medication aide instructor certification, and prior experience in geriatric nursing, teaching, or supervision.

Work Environment and Physical Requirements

Reasonable accommodation may be made for individuals with disabilities.

  • Must be able to move throughout the facility.
  • May spend extended periods sitting at a desk or using a computer.
  • Must be able to lift up to 35 pounds and assist with moving individuals safely.

Join Trinity Oaks Health & Rehab, a Lutheran Services Carolinas community, and help support staff education, quality care, and a strong team environment.

title: Designer (AutoCAD Civil 3D)
description:

Geosyntec has an exciting opportunity for a Designer (AutoCAD Civil 3D) in one of our Florida (Orlando, Tampa, Jacksonville, Boca Raton, Pensacola, Tallahassee) offices. The position will perform computer-aided design and drafting (CADD) for a variety of civil and geotechnical engineering design projects including developing layouts, grading plans and details for civil engineering projects, including landfills, industrial sites and utilities. Projects also include mechanical drawing systems and opportunities to contribute from the conceptual design stage through construction.

Geosyntec is an innovative, international engineering and consulting firm serving private and public-sector clients to address new ventures and complex problems involving our environment, natural resources, and civil infrastructure. Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Draft, edit, and finalize design plans and details using appropriate and efficient methods and adhering to Geosyntec drafting standards;

  • Analyze sketches, notes and other input material to determine best approach to complete a drawing set;
  • Manage the production of drawing sets from creation, markup and modification based on overall design;

  • Work collaboratively with other Geosyntec CADD practitioners to prepare design drawings and details and reviewing completed work products to ensure quality.

Skills, Experience and Qualifications

  • Associate’s degree in Drafting and a minimum of five (5) years related experience in a professional civil engineering setting; or equivalent combination of education, training and experience that provides the knowledge, skills and abilities to perform the responsibilities of the position. (required)
  • Successful Autodesk AutoCAD Certified Professional examination within the last 3 years. (preferred)
  • Experience developing and working with grading plans, cross-sections, alignments, profiles, three-dimensional surfaces, and earthwork volumes for landfills and other large civil design projects. (required)
  • Experience using/incorporating land or aerial surveying/mapping data and files. (required)
  • Experience with stormwater management design. (preferred)
  • Understanding of the latest releases of Microsoft Windows, Outlook, Word, Excel, Skype, Adobe PDF, and Windows File Explorer.
  • Experience with ArcGIS and MicroStation. (preferred)
  • Proficiency in the latest releases of AutoCAD, AutoCAD Civil 3D, and AutoCAD Map3D. Proficiency includes a strong understanding of Civil 3D Annotation styles and annotation tools, object and label styles, solid understanding of key objects such as Surfaces, Alignments, Profiles, Profile Views, Pipe Networks, Surface Analyses and Volume Calculations. (required)

title: Shift Supervior - 2nd Shift - Injection Molding
description:
Deckorators, a UFP Industries brand, creates innovative decking, railing, and outdoor-living products that combine performance, durability, and standout design.

We are looking for a hands-on manufacturing leader to help us continue delivering the quality and innovation our customers expect. This is an opportunity to lead people, improve processes, and play an important role in the production of products used to create outdoor spaces that stand out.

Job Summary

The Injection Molding Supervisor is responsible for leading the people, equipment, and production activities assigned to the second shift.

This individual oversees the daily operation of the injection molding department, including employee performance, production scheduling, machine and mold utilization, product quality, safety, and continuous improvement.

The ideal candidate has direct plastic injection molding experience, understands how to balance production demands with people leadership, and is comfortable working alongside employees to resolve issues and improve results. Experience with PVC injection molding is strongly preferred.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead the daily operations of the injection molding department during second shift.

  • Direct, train, coach, and develop production employees.

  • Communicate daily production priorities, expectations, and performance results to the team.

  • Assign employees and equipment based on production schedules, staffing needs, machine availability, and mold capacity.

  • Monitor production performance and make adjustments to meet safety, quality, cost, and output expectations.

  • Oversee the setup, operation, and performance of injection molding machines and related equipment.

  • Ensure required process checks, production documentation, and quality inspections are completed accurately and on time.

  • Identify and resolve production, quality, staffing, and equipment-related issues.

  • Partner with Maintenance to coordinate preventive maintenance, machine repairs, mold changes, and equipment improvements.

  • Help reduce downtime, waste, overtime, and other production inefficiencies.

  • Maintain appropriate department inventory levels and support the accurate movement of materials.

  • Review employee performance and provide timely coaching, feedback, recognition, and corrective action when necessary.

  • Identify employees with the potential for additional training, responsibility, or advancement.

  • Ensure employees are properly trained before operating machinery or performing assigned work.

  • Lead and support continuous-improvement initiatives, including 5S, total productive maintenance, standard work, and waste reduction.

  • Use production data and visual-management tools to communicate priorities and track department performance.

  • Conduct routine machine, process, housekeeping, and safety audits.

  • Ensure compliance with company policies, operating procedures, quality standards, and applicable laws and regulations.

  • Promote a safety-first culture and ensure employees consistently follow required safety procedures and use appropriate personal protective equipment.

  • Support job-safety analyses, lockout/tagout requirements, machine guarding, and other plant safety programs.

  • Participate in safety meetings and help implement corrective and preventive actions.

  • Prepare production reports and maintain required department records.

  • Communicate regularly with management and other departments regarding production status, staffing, equipment, quality, and operational concerns.

  • Complete company forklift training and assist with material movement when needed.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Direct experience working with plastic injection molding processes and equipment is required.

  • PVC injection molding experience is strongly preferred.

  • Two to four years of manufacturing experience required.

  • One to three years of experience leading, supervising, or managing employees required.

  • Post-secondary education, technical training, or equivalent relevant manufacturing leadership experience required.

  • Working knowledge of injection molding machines, molds, processing requirements, and production workflows.

  • Understanding of preventive maintenance, machine troubleshooting, and standard work instructions.

  • Knowledge of manufacturing safety practices, including lockout/tagout and machine guarding.

  • Familiarity with continuous-improvement principles such as 5S and total productive maintenance.

  • Strong understanding of quality standards, process controls, and production documentation.

  • Ability to organize people, machines, materials, and schedules in a fast-paced production environment.

  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to coach employees, establish expectations, and hold team members accountable.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate reporting.

  • Ability to identify production issues, determine root causes, and implement practical solutions.

  • Comfortable learning company systems, production-reporting tools, and internal procedures.

  • Ability to successfully complete the company’s forklift-licensing process.

What Will Help You Succeed

  • You are comfortable being visible and engaged on the production floor.

  • You can maintain accountability while treating employees fairly and respectfully.

  • You understand that safety, quality, and production performance must work together.

  • You communicate expectations clearly and follow through consistently.

  • You are willing to challenge inefficient processes and help develop better ways of working.

  • You remain organized and steady when production priorities change.

  • You take ownership of problems and work collaboratively to resolve them.

Why Join Deckorators?

  • Lead an important manufacturing operation for a growing outdoor-living brand.

  • Work with advanced injection molding machines and production technology.

  • Have a direct impact on employee development, product quality, and operational performance.

  • Help implement continuous improvements instead of simply maintaining existing processes.

title: Director, Sub Assemblies Manufacturing
description:
At Vast, our mission is to contribute to a future where billions of people are living and thriving in space. Vast is developing next-generation space stations to ensure a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and unlocking a new space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Using an incremental, hardware-rich and low-cost approach, Vast is rapidly developing its multi-module Haven Station. Haven Demo’s 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to fly and operate its own spacecraft. Next, Haven-1 is expected to become the world’s first commercial space station when it launches, followed by additional Haven modules to enable permanent human presence by 2030. Our team is all-in, committed to executing our mission safely and on time. If you want to work with the most talented people on Earth furthering space exploration for humanity, come join us.

Vast is looking for a(n) Director, Sub Assemblies Manufacturing, reporting to the Vice President of Manufacturing, to support the development of the systems that will be required for the design and build of human-rated space stations.

This will be a full-time, exempt position located in our Long Beach location.

Responsibilities:

  • Define and execute the manufacturing strategy for mechanical subassemblies, Thermal Control Systems (TCS), and Environmental Control & Life Support Systems (ECLSS), aligning manufacturing capability with spacecraft performance, build schedules, and mission objectives.
  • Lead cross-functional manufacturing execution across engineering, quality, supply chain, and test to drive production readiness, resolve manufacturing constraints, and enable successful hardware delivery.
  • Translate program requirements and build cadence into manufacturing operating models, resource plans, factory layouts, work center architecture, and capacity roadmaps.
  • Drive Design for Manufacturability (DFM), Design for Assembly (DFA), and Design for Test (DFT) through early engagement with engineering, influencing product architecture, interface definitions, test access, tolerance schemes, and manufacturing risk before release.
  • Own prototype-to-production transitions by establishing manufacturing work centers, qualifying tooling and processes, developing production documentation, and enabling repeatable flight hardware production.
  • Develop make/buy strategies and manufacturing capability roadmaps, determining which subassemblies, fabrication processes, and test operations should be vertically integrated versus outsourced.
  • Establish manufacturing quality standards and production readiness gates, ensuring compliance with AS9100, NASA human-rated requirements, and disciplined configuration control throughout the hardware lifecycle.
  • Drive manufacturing performance through digital production systems and data analytics, leveraging MES, Jira, Tableau, and operational metrics to improve throughput, yield, nonconformance resolution, and factory performance.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives across mechanical assembly, tubing, thermal systems, and ECLSS manufacturing by applying lean principles, standard work, and production system optimization to improve safety, quality, delivery, and cost.
  • Build, mentor, and develop high-performing manufacturing engineering, test engineering, and technician organizations while establishing the manufacturing culture, operating rhythm, and technical standards required to scale future spacecraft production.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 10+ years of experience leading manufacturing engineering or production organizations responsible for complex hardware from development through production, including 8+ years of people leadership.
  • Demonstrated expertise manufacturing complex mechanical assemblies, fluid systems, thermal hardware, tubing, or other high-reliability electromechanical systems.
  • Proven experience driving Design for Manufacturability (DFM), production readiness, manufacturing process development, and prototype-to-production transitions.
  • Experience building and scaling manufacturing organizations, including work center design, production ramp, capacity planning, and cross-functional execution with engineering, quality, and supply chain.
  • Working knowledge of regulated manufacturing systems (AS9100, NASA, or equivalent), manufacturing documentation, inspection methods, contamination control, and production test.
  • Experience applying lean manufacturing principles and modern manufacturing systems (CAD, PLM, MES/ERP, or similar) to improve quality, throughput, and operational performance.
  • Strong technical judgment, communication, and leadership skills with the ability to influence engineering decisions and solve complex manufacturing challenges.

Preferred Skills and Experience:

  • Experience standing up new manufacturing capabilities, factories, or production lines from early development through sustained production.
  • Experience supporting spacecraft, launch vehicle, aviation, defense, energy, automotive, or other highly regulated hardware manufacturing environments.
  • Experience developing make/buy strategies, supplier qualification plans, and vertically integrated manufacturing capabilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead organizations through ambiguity, shifting program priorities, and aggressive development schedules while maintaining execution.
  • Track record of building high-performing manufacturing engineering teams and developing future technical and people leaders.
  • Experience driving digital manufacturing initiatives, automation, advanced manufacturing technologies, or factory modernization efforts.

Additional Requirements:

  • Willingness to work evenings and/or weekends to support critical mission milestones.
  • Ability to lift up to 25 lbs unassisted.
Pay Range: California
$188,660—$267,720 USD

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

Base salary will vary depending on job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, business needs, and market demand. Salary is just one component of our comprehensive compensation package. Full-time employees also receive company equity, as well as access to a full suite of compelling benefits and perks, including: medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents, generous paid time off; up to 20+ days of vacation for exempt staff and up to 10+ days of vacation for non-exempt staff with the ability to cash-out unused vacation annually, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, ClassPass credits, personalized mental healthcare through Spring Health, and other discounts and perks. We also take pride in offering exceptional food perks, with snacks, drip coffee & onsite barista, cold drinks, and dinner meals remaining free of charge, and lunch subsidized as part of Vast’s ongoing commitment to providing high-quality meals for employees.

title: Automotive Mechanics
description:
Mavis Tires & Brakes at Discount Prices - Automotive Mechanics


Put your career into high gear with Mavis Tires & Brakes at Discount Prices! We're looking for full-time Automotive Mechanics to join Team Mavis at one of our state-of-the-art automotive service, repair, and tire sales centers in the Selma, AL area. With over 2,000 retail locations, Mavis is one of the largest tire sales and automotive repair chains in the United States.

About the Position of Automotive Mechanic

As Mavis's leaders in undercar repairs, our Automotive Mechanics are trusted to inspect, diagnose, and perform a wide variety of automotive services on customers' vehicles. Mavis's Automotive Mechanics perform a wide variety of undercar repairs, including brakes, struts, and shocks. Automotive Mechanics are also responsible for completing state-mandated inspections, changing oil and filters, checking fluids, replacing worn parts, and dismounting, mounting, rotating, and balancing tires.

Employee Benefits

At Mavis, we understand that our people drive our success. We provide our team members with competitive weekly pay, including weekly incentive compensation, a good working environment and an excellent combination of additional benefits like health, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) retirement savings plan with employer match, paid vacations, paid time off, paid holidays, life insurance, on-the-job training, and opportunities for career growth and advancement.

Qualifications

We recruit team members who share our commitment to providing complete customer satisfaction and delivering the highest quality service. To be eligible for the position of Automotive Mechanic, you must (1) be at least 18 years of age; (2) be legally authorized to work in the United States; (3) possess 2 years of experience and/or training in automotive repair and maintenance or any combination of education, training and experience which demonstrates the ability to perform the duties and responsibilities of the position; and (4) possess an extensive tool box of personal tools used in performing undercar repairs.

The following additional qualifications are preferred: (1) state inspection license(s); and (2) ASE Certifications in Automotive Maintenance and Light Repair (G1), Suspension and Steering (A4), and Brakes (A5).

As an active position, Automotive mechanics are required to stand, walk, bend, kneel, stoop, crouch, crawl, climb, pull, reach and perform repeated and repetitive movements consistent with vehicle maintenance and automotive repair. title: Corporate Security Specialist
description:
As a Corporate Security Specialist at Wellmark, you will play an important role in supporting the safety and security of company assets, facilities, and personnel. In this position, you will conduct routine patrols, monitor security systems, and respond to incidents with a calm and professional approach. Serving as a visible on-site presence, you will help deter potential threats while contributing to a safe and secure environment for employees, visitors, and stakeholders. You will work closely with other members of the security team and partner with internal departments and external emergency personnel to support day-to-day security operations and response efforts.

The ideal candidate has experience in corporate security, law enforcement, and/or military service. You bring a basic understanding of security operations, incident response, and risk awareness, along with the ability to remain composed and follow established procedures in high-pressure situations. You demonstrate strong communication and interpersonal skills, and have at least foundational expefrience in conflict resolution and de-escalation techniques. Professionalism, attention to detail, and the ability to handle sensitive information with discretion are essential. Familiarity with security technologies, defensive tactics, and emergency medical protocols (such as AED use) is beneficial, with training and certification opportunities provided. You are a dependable team player who is eager to grow your skills and contribute to maintaining a safe and secure environment.

Required:

  • High school diploma or equivalent (bachelor’s degree in security management or related field preferred).
  • 2+ years of experience in a security role, preferably within a corporate environment or a related security/protective services role; or equivalent training or experience (i.e. military or law enforcement training and experience).
  • Demonstrated expertise in risk assessment, and emergency response.
  • Conflict resolution skills, including the ability to de-escalate situations and engage with offenders.
  • Familiarity with emergency medical protocols (e.g. TCCC/TECC), AED operation, and crisis response strategies.
  • Ability to think critically, applying logic and sound judgment in high-pressure situations to assess threats and respond appropriately.
  • Demonstrable knowledge of defensive tactics and security equipment.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and demonstrate professionalism, especially when handling sensitive security information or incidents.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a security team, supporting internal departments and interfacing with external emergency personnel as needed.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, nights and weekends.
  • Axon certification required, or ability to obtain certification within 6 months of hire.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to travel as needed.

Preferred:

  • 5+ years of experience in a security role or a related security/protective services role; or equivalent training or experience (i.e. military or law enforcement training and experience).
  • Certified Protection Professional (CPP) or equivalent certification.
  • Military or law enforcement background.
  • Experience in corporate security or high-profile executive protection.
  • Familiarity with and the ability to be certified with limited security defensive equipment.

a. Conduct regular patrols of company premises to ensure the safety and security of assets, facilities, and personnel.

b. Monitor security systems, including access control, surveillance cameras, and alarm systems.

c. Respond to security incidents, emergencies, and threats, implementing defensive tactics when necessary.

d. Conduct risk assessments and report potential security vulnerabilities.

e. Respond to emergency/medical situations, serving as the intermediary with emergency response personnel, conveying information to the emergency.

f. Secure premises and personnel and prevent losses and damage by reporting irregularities. Maintain detailed records of security activities and incidents.

g. Coordinate with local law enforcement and emergency services as needed.

h. Ensure compliance with company policies and industry standards for corporate security.

i. May provide security support for corporate events and meetings and business-related initiatives as needed.

j. May conduct security training and awareness programs for employees as needed.

k. Other duties as assigned.

Office-based: The nature of the job duties for this position will require you to be in the office 100% of the time. Your presence in-office is critical to effectively perform the responsibilities of the role. Occasional remote work may be permitted based on workload and/or other ad-hoc situations that support it, with manager approval.

title: Supervisor
description:

Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Minimum Qualification: Graduate (mandatory)

Role Overview:

The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.

This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Site Operations Oversight:

  • Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
  • Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
  • Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
  • Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
  • Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
  • Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
  • Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost & found registers.
  • Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
  • Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.

2. Technical Systems & Documentation:

  • Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
  • Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
  • Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
  • Take access approvals via eApproval portals.

3. Reporting & MIS:

  • Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
  • Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
  • Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.

4. Emergency & Incident Management:

  • Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
  • Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
  • Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
  • Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.

5. Client & Stakeholder Coordination:

  • Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
  • Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
  • Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
  • Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.

6. G4S Internal Coordination:

  • Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
  • Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
  • Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
  • Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.

Candidate Profile:

Minimum Requirements:

  • Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
  • Minimum 5–10 years of experience in security operations management
  • Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
  • Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.

Essential Competencies:

  • Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
  • Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
  • Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
  • Leadership & Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
  • Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

  • 100% compliance in daily deployment & reporting
  • ≥95% uptime for security equipment and systems
  • ≤2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
  • SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
  • Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores ≥90%

title: Remote Physician Pro Fee Coding Specialist-Anesthesia
description:
Job Summary

The Remote Physician Pro Fee Coding Specialist-Anesthesia is responsible for reviewing, analyzing, and assigning accurate CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 codes for professional fee services documented in the medical record. This role ensures proper sequencing, modifier use, and place-of-service coding in compliance with governmental regulations, third-party payer policies, and corporate standards. The Physician Coder plays a key role in revenue cycle accuracy by identifying documentation gaps, ensuring coding integrity, and working collaboratively with internal teams to support physician coding compliance and reimbursement.

Essential Functions

  • Assigns accurate CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 codes for professional services, procedures, diagnoses, and treatments based on provider documentation.
  • Ensures compliance with governmental regulations, third-party payer policies, and corporate coding protocols, following National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI) edits, Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs), and National Coverage Determinations (NCDs).
  • Performs coding audits and quality reviews, verifying accuracy of documentation and identifying areas for provider education.
  • Works coding-related claim edits, holds, and scrubs in the electronic billing system (e.g., Athena Collector), ensuring timely claim resolution and reimbursement.
  • Collaborates with physicians, revenue cycle teams, and coding education staff, requesting clarification when necessary to ensure optimal documentation and compliance.
  • Performs edit checks on coded data before transmittal, identifying and correcting errors as needed.
  • Maintains strict confidentiality of patient records, provider information, and financial data, adhering to HIPAA and corporate compliance policies.
  • Escalates documentation or coding issues to the coding education team for provider training and improved documentation practices.
  • Assists in coding-related special projects, ensuring accurate reporting and analysis of coding data for operational improvement.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Qualifications

  • H.S. Diploma or GED required
  • Associate Degree in Health Information Management, Healthcare Administration, or a related field preferred
  • 2-4 years of experience in physician coding, professional fee coding, or medical billing required
  • Experience with multiple specialties, surgical coding, or high-volume professional fee coding preferred

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of ICD-10, CPT, and HCPCS coding systems for physician/professional fee services.
  • Understanding of modifier usage, place-of-service coding, and payer billing guidelines.
  • Experience with electronic health records (EHR), coding software, and claim processing systems.
  • Ability to identify documentation deficiencies and escalate for provider education.
  • Familiarity with NCCI edits, LCD/NCD guidelines, and medical necessity requirements.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, ensuring accurate coding and optimal reimbursement.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills, working with providers, revenue cycle teams, and compliance staff.

Licenses and Certifications

  • Certified Coder-AHIMA or AAPC (CPC) required or
  • CCS-Certified Coding Specialist (CCS-P) required
  • Additional certifications such as Certified Evaluation and Management Coder (CEMC) or Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT) preferred

title: Principal Product Manager, Reporting and Measurement
description:
Tatari is on a mission to revolutionize TV advertising. Founded in 2016 to help transform the antiquated world of TV advertising through the intelligent application of AI and machine learning, Tatari helps some of the world’s fastest growing brands including Chime, Calm, Tecovas, Manscaped, Saatva, and Liquid I.V., reach their customers using linear and streaming TV ads. Our platform combines sophisticated media buying with proprietary analytics to turn TV advertising into an automated, digital-like experience, enabling businesses of any size to advertise on TV.

That approach has earned Tatari broad industry recognition, including being named Best CTV AdTech Platform in the 8th annual MarTech Breakthrough Awards, as well as honors from Digiday (Best Connected TV Platform), AdExchanger (Most Innovative TV Advertising Technology), and Business Insider (Hottest AdTech Companies). Tatari has also been recognized as the Best Place to Work by Inc. Magazine. Backed by an executive team of former founders and senior leaders from companies including Shazam, TrueCar, AdapTV, LiveRail, Amazon, Google, Meta, Microsoft, and Yahoo, Tatari continues to scale rapidly as TV advertising enters its next major era.

We are looking for a Principal Product Managers in the Reporting and Measurement pillar. As a Principal Product Manager, you will work closely with design, engineering, and data science teams to bring Tatari’s vision to life. You will partner with senior members on the team to define and own the roadmap within the “Intuitive Reporting” Team. Measurement is at the heart of Tatari’s business and this team’s mission is to leverage new data sources that prove the full and true value of TV campaigns (beyond just website conversions). You will need to understand the changing business models of our customers and how we can best leverage data and analytics to drive the right business outcomes for them. Your ability to understand the needs of our marketer users and how to prioritize our engineering efforts to meet those needs will determine success in this role.

Intuitive Reporting: This team follows the mission embedded in its name. Reporting on TV performance needs to intuitively make sense to the marketers we serve. This role in particular will be aligned with the needs of our brands who are not satisfied with our typical CPA, ROAS, and other conversion metrics, but instead need brand metrics, audience metrics, upper funnel analytics, and custom DS support. This is a data heavy role and will require expertise in data pipelines, data science driven analytics, and data visualization and storytelling. The ideal candidate needs to be able to discuss novel DS techniques for handling this big data problem as well as design choices for an intuitive presentation of the calculations.

Responsibilities:

  • Under the guidance of other senior members on the team, manage the entire product life cycle from ideation to prototyping, testing, design, launch, and post launch analytics.
  • Collaborate with various stakeholders within the company: engineering, media-buying, data science, sales, marketing and client management.
  • Help define the company’s product roadmap, both short and long term. Ability to translate the company vision into specific product solutions.
  • Provide thought leadership, management, and execution in the delivery of data initiatives aimed at driving extraordinary results for TV advertisers.
  • Understand our customers and their requirements. Synthesize compelling product features for proving the full impact of their TV marketing campaigns. Balance between what is possible today, and what we should plan for tomorrow.
  • Keep a finger on the pulse of the industry and our competition, and position Tatari’s products accordingly.

Qualifications:

  • 6+ years of product management experience, with particular emphasis in customer-facing data & analytics products. Bonus for advertising or marketing technology.
  • Proven ability to work in a high-ambiguity environment.
  • A passion for delivering features that leverage data, analytics, and ML/GenAI to elegantly solve customer problems. Strong analytics sense with the ability to extract meaningful signals from large amounts of data. Strong ability in building and telling stories through data visualization.
  • Experience and strength in partnering closely with Design to address problems and varying customer needs through effective user research and product design.
  • Strong communicator with excellent people skills to interact with various teams inside the company, clients, and vendors. Including a demonstrable ability to present a case for your roadmap and initiatives to senior leadership in a clear and compelling manner that inspires investment.
  • Demonstrated success developing high-leverage features that delight customers, are hard to copy, and grow the business.
  • The usual product management skills: customer-needs obsessed, Agile-fluent, black-belt user story and solution creation, strong written & verbal communicator with excellent people skills, highly organized and detail-oriented, passionate about solving customer problems.
  • Hands-on experience specifying and shipping products built on ETL and calculation pipelines. You can partner with engineering and DS on pipeline design, data modeling, and the tradeoffs between batch vs. real-time computation, and you're comfortable reasoning about how a metric is computed end-to-end, not just what it shows.
  • Familiarity with audience and reach measurement e.g., Nielsen ONE, cross-platform reach/frequency, deduplicated audience metrics, incremental reach, or comparable currency/panel-based measurement.
  • Understanding of TV/advertising measurement beyond direct-response (CPA/ROAS): brand lift, upper-funnel, and audience-based metrics, including how they're modeled and where their limitations lie.

Benefits

  • Total compensation ($175,000 - $225,000) + Equity
  • Health insurance coverage for you and your dependents
  • 401K, FSA, and commuter benefits
  • $150 monthly spending account
  • $1,000 annual continued education benefit
  • $500 Newbie Productivity Perk
  • Unlimited PTO and sick days
  • Monthly Company Wellness Day Off
  • Snacks, drinks, and catered lunches at the office
  • Team building events
  • Hybrid RTO of 2 days per week in office

Duties may include but are not limited to: the examination, synthesis, and evaluation of medical records; the abstraction and recording of pertinent medical information; retrieves archival tissue samples at outside institutions when relevant for translational studies; coordinates the collection, processing, organization, and storage of biological specimens (including but not limited to blood, tissue, stool); and the organization and collation of biospecimens collected within Breast oncology cohort studies.

Located in Boston and the surrounding communities, Dana-Farber Cancer Institute is a leader in life changing breakthroughs in cancer research and patient care. We are united in our mission of conquering cancer, HIV/AIDS, and related diseases. We strive to create an inclusive, diverse, and equitable environment where we provide compassionate and comprehensive care to patients of all backgrounds, and design programs to promote public health particularly among high-risk and underserved populations. We conduct groundbreaking research that advances treatment, we educate tomorrow's physician/researchers, and we work with amazing partners, including other Harvard Medical School-affiliated hospitals.

  • Responsible for reviewing and abstracting the medical records for research patients on trials they are assigned

  • Entering identified clinical data points in the corresponding database

  • Ensuring that data is entered within the outlined timelines for each trial

  • Evaluating and tracking the eligibility of all patients seen in the clinic for inclusion in the study

  • Bone Marrow Transplant (BMT) RDS positions:

  • Ensure case management documentation in patient medical records and other information management systems as assigned to support clinical program clinical care

  • Perform QA and QC procedures to ensure optimal data reporting as assigned

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES REQUIRED:

Direct staff to plan and conduct proactive safety analysis with respect to the SHSP emphasis areas. Lead safety analysis and research methods to ensure that study findings are thorough and accurate. Direct and schedule the timely compilation of crash data for annual summary report and documentation of trends for each highway system. Direct training of internal customers on the use of safety software and methods in the HSM and performing safety studies. Update policies and procedures to meet FHWA requirements, stream-line, focus the process, and reduce project schedules. Disseminate and post documents. Update improvement project prioritization. Working with partners track procedures and software. Ensure field reviews are conducted and crash analysis is performed for countermeasures. Direct the compilation and analysis of project implementation and effectiveness (before and after crash data) to complete the annual HSIP report. Ensure review and implementation of new safety analysis techniques and software, such as Safety Analyst.
  • Leadership and Program Support: Provide leadership and direction to assigned engineering team. Provide technical support and assistance to VDOT staff in other divisions or districts on projects as needed to meet goals. Prepare and review technical reports. Act as team and technical lead for projects and proposals. Provides technical leadership to engineers and technical staff. Manage and lead the development of final pavement marking, pavement marker, sign plans and other traffic control device plans. Provide guidance to field applications of work zones and review the recommended adjustments. Respond to requests from Residency staff for assistance in setting up traffic control layouts and devices in emergency response situations.

Acadian Asset Management is a global, systematic investment manager at the forefront of data-driven investing since 1986. Headquartered in Boston, with locations in Singapore, London, and Sydney, we manage over $195 billion on behalf of leading institutions worldwide—including pension funds, endowments, foundations, and sovereign wealth funds. We harness advanced technology, rich datasets, and multidisciplinary expertise to help clients navigate complex markets and uncover insights that may be overlooked by traditional approaches.

What sets Acadian apart is our people. We foster a collaborative, intellectually curious environment where ideas are tested, diverse perspectives are welcomed, and innovation thrives. Unlike a traditional stewardship role, this position sits within a quantitative investment environment and will help drive Acadian's ESG research by combining direct company engagements with the development of scalable research tools and datasets. title: Lead Integration & Test Engineer (Starshield)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

LEAD INTEGRATION & TEST ENGINEER (STARSHIELD)

Starshield leverages SpaceX's Starlink technology and launch capability to support national security efforts. While Starlink is designed for consumer and commercial use, Starshield is designed for government use, with an initial focus on three areas: Earth observation, communications, and hosted payloads. Designed to meet diverse mission requirements, Starshield satellites are capable of integrating a wide variety of payloads, offering unique versatility to users. With the proven ability to iterate rapidly, SpaceX's unique full-stack approach in developing end-to-end systems, from launch vehicles to user terminals, enables the deployment of capabilities at scale with unprecedented speed. Starshield's proliferated low-Earth orbit architecture provides inherent resiliency and constant connectivity to on-orbit assets, while SpaceX's proven rapid launch capability provides expedient and economical access to space.

As a Lead Integration & Test Engineer, you will lead and grow a team of engineers and specialists charged with developing, scaling, and maintaining the manufacturing facilities and processes to build, test, integrate, and launch cutting- edge satellite hardware.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead a team of engineers and specialists in defining processes, shaping build, test, and shipping infrastructure, and designing fixtures/tools/production aids to produce satellites and satellite subassemblies.
  • Support day-to-day execution of hardware production and vehicle integration.
  • Ensure that satellite manufacturing is safe, secure, reliable, on time, cost effective and efficient and produces satellites that perform properly on orbit.
  • Challenge design requirements, delete unnecessary process steps, simplify and optimize production, accelerate build rates, and increase production line automation as appropriate.
  • Implement continuous improvements to upgrade current production controls, employ new ones as needed, and minimize the probability of errors.
  • Maintain a working knowledge of each system on the satellite including the design, schematics, operations, manufacturing, testing, and flight.
  • Increase program manufacturing and testing capabilities and capacity.
  • Evaluate non-conformances, and identifying patterns of issues to determine root cause and create actionable items and system improvements.
  • Identify opportunities for team growth and propose/develop training to increase the effectiveness of the engineering team with respect to company strategy.
  • Set clear/achievable goals and hold team members accountable for execution and continuous improvement in their area of ownership.
  • Own the relationship with design, supply chain, mission management, Starshield customers, and other partner teams.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline or physics.
  • 2+ years of professional design and/or manufacturing experience within aerospace, automotive, industrial, or consumer electronics industries.
  • 1+ years of leadership experience leading teams, projects or people.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • 5+ years of professional design and/or hands-on manufacturing experience.
  • 3+ years of prior leadership experience leading teams, projects or people.
  • Previous experience in a professional leadership role.
  • Master's degree in engineering or related discipline.
  • Strong sense of accountability, integrity, work ethic, and drive to succeed.
  • Strong interpersonal and organizational skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience with build, integration, and testing of complex propulsion, thermal, electrical and/or structural parts, assemblies, and systems.
  • Experience working in a production environment with both high rate and high mix of products.
  • Experience succeeding in a rapidly evolving and schedule-driven production environment with process development of high-reliability and high-quality hardware from R&D to high-volume manufacturing.
  • Experience making impactful decisions using engineering intuition and critical thinking without all information being available.
  • Professional experience working with large assembly moves (e.g., crane operations).
  • Experience writing work instructions, test plans, and procedures.
  • Experience with documentation and configuration management.
  • Experience with mechanical component and/or tooling design and analysis (3D computer-aided design).
  • Knowledge of available manufacturing techniques, processes, and equipment capabilities.
  • Experience with PCB/PCBA fabrication and testing methodologies.
  • Experience working with GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing) and familiarity with complex tolerance stack-ups.
  • Basic proficiency with using SQL, Power BI, and other database tools to drive decision making.
  • Knowledge of quality tools such as Lean principles, Six Sigma, Root Cause Analysis and Corrective Action, Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), Metrology, Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA), Control Plans, and various problem-solving approaches.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Ability to work extended hours or weekends as needed.
  • Must be able to travel to SpaceX and partner facilities - up to 10%.
  • This position is very hands-on and may require you to be on your feet for extended periods of time, up to 4 hours, and may require you to be able to climb ladders, stoop, bend, crawl, and work in tight spaces.

You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:
