title: DSP DSA I/DD - Community Activities and Social Events
description:
Direct Support Professional (DSA) – Community Activities & Social Events

Access Community Care | Beaverton, OR
Full-Time | 35-40 Hours per Week


Make a Difference. Build Friendships. Create Meaningful Experiences.

Are you someone who loves being out in the community, planning fun activities, and helping others live their best lives? Do you enjoy building relationships and making a positive impact every day?

At Access Community Care (ACC), we're looking for compassionate, dependable, and energetic individuals to join our team as a Direct Support Professional (DSA). In this role, you'll support adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities as they participate in community events, build friendships, develop social skills, and explore new experiences.

No two days are the same! From bowling, hiking, and movies to museums, community events, volunteering, and local attractions—you'll help create memorable experiences while empowering individuals to achieve their personal goals.


What You'll Do

As a Direct Support Professional, you will:

  • Lead engaging community outings and activities for groups of up to 8 participants.
  • Safely transport participants to and from scheduled activities.
  • Encourage independence, socialization, and community inclusion.
  • Help individuals achieve personal goals outlined in their support plans.
  • Foster meaningful friendships and positive social interactions.
  • Support participants with budgeting and managing spending during activities.
  • Complete daily documentation including progress notes, daily logs, and incident reports before the end of each shift.
  • Maintain open communication with your team and supervisors.
  • Ensure the health, safety, dignity, and rights of every individual you support.
  • Occasionally provide one-on-one support when needed.


What We're Looking For

We're looking for people who are:

  • Compassionate and patient
  • Dependable and trustworthy
  • Positive, energetic, and self-motivated
  • Comfortable leading small groups
  • Excellent communicators
  • Flexible and adaptable
  • Passionate about helping others reach their goals
  • Team players with strong integrity


Minimum Qualifications

  • Must be at least 18 years old
  • High school diploma or GED
  • Valid driver's license
  • Reliable personal vehicle
  • Current auto insurance
  • Good driving record
  • Ability to pass state-required background checks
  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, and lift up to 20 pounds
  • Basic computer and documentation skills
  • Ability to communicate effectively in English

Experience supporting individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities is preferred but not required—we provide training for the right candidate!


Why You'll Love Working at ACC

At Access Community Care, we believe every person deserves the opportunity to live a full, meaningful life. Our team is committed to creating inclusive experiences where individuals build confidence, independence, and lasting friendships.

When you join ACC, you'll become part of a supportive team that values:

  • Respect
  • Inclusion
  • Integrity
  • Compassion
  • Teamwork
  • Professional Growth

Every day is an opportunity to make a genuine difference in someone's life.


Schedule

  • Full-Time
  • 35-40 hours per week
  • Flexible schedule including daytime, evenings, and occasional weekends based on community activities and participant needs.


Join Our Team!

If you're looking for more than just a job—if you want a career where you can make a lasting impact while having fun in the community—we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and help empower people to live their best lives!

title: Commerce Partnerships Writer
location: United States; New York, United States
description:
This assignment posting is for an Agency Worker opportunity with People Inc. The Agency Worker is paid by a staffing agency employer. Agency Workers will receive a W2 from the staffing agency reporting their earnings for tax purposes.

Commerce Partnerships Writer

People Inc. is looking for a writer to support the Partnerships News & Deals team to cover timely travel, fashion, and lifestyle-related shopping content on celebrities, trends, reviews, and more for PEOPLE and InStyle. We’re looking for someone who can cover everything from single-product features to sale roundups and spot customer-loved pieces, seasonal and trending items, and more. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who is passionate about and has experience with commerce-focused stories, can create quality content, and thrives in a fast-paced environment.

Assignment Details:

This is a 40-hour/week contract position with a rate of $32/hour beginning as soon as the right candidate is able. The contract duration is 6 months with the potential to extend. Writers must be based in the U.S. in EST and be comfortable working remotely or near the People Inc. office in New York City.

Assignment Responsibilities:

  • Pitch and write two shopping articles per day, averaging 8 to 10 per week

  • Identify and carry out commerce content opportunities within various lifestyle categories including fashion, travel, and beauty, specific to PEOPLE and InStyle

  • Write and update stories for commerce tentpoles like Black Friday and Prime Day with the flexibility to contribute to team goals off hours during these events

  • Work across various edit goals with different KPIs and content strategies

  • Use data and analytics to brainstorm and guide content decisions

  • Collaborate closely with numerous writers and editors both on and outside of the Partnerships Vertical

  • Monitor social media (TikTok, Instagram, etc.) for commerce opportunities, including viral products and celebrity mentions

  • Build, edit, and update content within the CMS

  • Reach out to high-quality experts to provide background information and quotes as needed.

Skills/Experience:

  • A commerce writer with at least 2+ years of experience

  • Passionate about and/or knowledgeable of the lifestyle commerce space and enthusiastic about finding the best products out there

  • Experience covering tentpole shopping holidays like Black Friday and Prime Day

  • Detail-oriented and deadline-focused

  • Experienced in executing SEO best practices

  • A strong writer capable of creating engaging, lively headlines and working across several priorities at a time, all while keeping the brand voice, values, and style in mind

  • A self-starter who can pivot seamlessly as new initiatives and priorities are identified

The Commerce team spirit embodies these core competencies:

  • Manage Ambiguity: You can comfortably deal with change and can decide/act without the total picture. You remain calm and productive while dealing constructively with problems that do not have clear solutions or outcomes.

  • Nimble Learning: You’re eager to actively learn through experimentation when tackling new problems, using both successes and failures as learning fodder.

  • Self-Development: You want to seek new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels. You show a personal commitment to continuously improving, accepting stretch opportunities, and making the most of available development resources.

About Us:

People Inc. is America’s largest digital and print publisher. Our 40+ iconic and fast-growing brands harness the best intent-driven content, the fastest sites, and the fewest ads to help nearly 200 million people every month, including 95 percent of US women, make decisions, take action, and find inspiration. People Inc. brands include PEOPLE, InStyle, Better Homes & Gardens, Verywell, FOOD & WINE, The Spruce, Allrecipes, Byrdie, REAL SIMPLE, Investopedia, Southern Living and more.

Please be aware of fraudulent recruiters offering opportunities at People Inc. If you are in conversations about a job opportunity and wish to confirm its validity, please reach out directly to hrconcerns@people.inc.

If interested, apply by emailing a PDF copy of your resume, three recent commerce writing clips, and a one-paragraph summary of your commerce experience to Bridget DeWald at bridget.degnan@people.inc and Michelle Parente at mparente@people.inc. Any application emails that do not adhere to these guidelines will not be considered.

3M Health Care is now Solventum

Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.

We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.

The Impact You’ll Make in this Role

Management of the site occupational health services. Provide professional advice to site leadership in regulatory compliance, occupational, and population health. Define and implement programs and projects in the occupational health field to meet company-wide health goals.

As a(n) Occupational Health Physician, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative and diverse people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:

  • Leadership for Occupational Health Services:

Responsible for direct delivery of on-site clinical services and operational management. Applies expert knowledge and extensive experience to administer appropriate clinical management. The activities include medical evaluation, assessment, and establishing a treatment plan. Provide care direction to attain adequate health recovery and prompt safely return to work.

The Solventum site medical supervisor applies expert knowledge and extensive experience in clinical operations to solve a variety of complex problems. The Solventum site medical supervisor leads the development and implementation of clinic protocols and procedures based on clinical practice standards and legislative requirements for clinical services. Supervises nursing and other clinical staff to ensure the proper functioning of the Occupational Health Services. Leads projects to continuously improve clinical services and efficiency.

  • Leadership for Solventum Occupational Health and Preventive Health Programs:

The Solventum Site Occupational Medicine Leader directs the Site’s Occupational Health and Preventive Health programs. According to the site population health needs and regulatory requirements, these programs may include occupational medical surveillance, pandemic preparedness, travel health, cardiovascular risk reduction, hypertension, etc. Responsibilities include program planning, development, implementation, and assessment according to professional and quality standards and policies. Work in partnership with the site Environmental Health and Safety, Human Resources and other stakeholders to provide professional advice on the wide range of Occupational Health and environmental health and safety programs not limited to: Medical Elements in the EHS Management Standard, clinical services, return to work, disability and case management.

The on-site medical leader is responsible for program implementation, determination of key process indicators, quality improvement, and overall program evaluation.

  • Business Unit/Plant/Locations Support:

The Solventum site medical leader is also recognized as a medical expert and professional consultant within the organization. Communicates and advises internal and external clients, such as Plant Manager, facility Environmental Health and Safety Manager, Human Resources Manager, and other site leaders on preventive health initiatives, occupational health programs, Solventum Global Health Standard, data privacy regulations, disability, and medical case management and other regulatory requirements. The on-site medical leader also interacts and collaborates with other country sites. The Solventum site medical supervisor communicates the human health effects of potential hazards and mitigating strategies to employees. Participates in and communicates results of human health investigations (such as investigation of infectious disease or cancer clusters at the location) to management, employees, and other stakeholders. The Solventum site medical supervisor manages approved the budget of the clinical service.

  • Supervision to on-site occupational health nurses and other health care professionals:

The Solventum site medical supervisor Provides direct supervision to assigned employees through leadership, coaching, training, and development. Allocates work assignments, reviews progress in achieving objectives, manages employee compensation, performance appraisals, diversity, disability, or relevant employee data. Understands and enforces corporate/location policies and procedures. Takes appropriate action to address policy violations. May manage workforce vendors and contracts.

title: Supervisor
description:
Job Description: Admin Support

Position Title: Admin Support
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Minimum Qualification: Graduate (mandatory)

Role Overview:

The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.

This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Site Operations Oversight:

  • Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
  • Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
  • Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
  • Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
  • Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
  • Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
  • Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost & found registers.
  • Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
  • Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.

2. Technical Systems & Documentation:

  • Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
  • Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
  • Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
  • Take access approvals via eApproval portals.

3. Reporting & MIS:

  • Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
  • Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
  • Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.

4. Emergency & Incident Management:

  • Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
  • Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
  • Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
  • Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.

title: Inside Sales Engineer - Nevada Systems Group
description:
About us: At Nevada Systems Group, we deliver HVAC systems designed for the unique demands of Las Vegas and Southern Nevada. From custom-engineered solutions to retrofit projects, our focus is on efficiency, reliability, and performance - reinforced by the expertise and service that set us apart.

Position Summary: This role is responsible for driving revenue growth through the application of engineered HVAC solutions within the commercial built environment. This role operates at the intersection of mechanical system design, applied engineering, and technical sales, supporting contractors, consulting engineers, architects, and end users across all phases of the project lifecycle - from conceptual design and equipment specification through procurement, installation, and commissioning. The position requires a strong understanding of HVAC system design principles, thermodynamics, psychometrics, and equipment performance characteristics, with specialized focus on commercial heating, ventilation, and air conditioning systems including air handlers, rooftop units, chillers, boilers, variable air volume (VAV) systems, energy recovery ventilators, and building automation controls.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute account strategies to grow market share within assigned territories, targeting mechanical contractors, consulting engineers, and design-build firms.
  • Analyze project plans, specifications, and schedules to identify opportunities for system optimization and equipment application.
  • Provide engineered equipment selections based on project requirements, including airflow calculations, static pressure analysis, thermal load considerations, and system compatibility assessments.
  • Support the design and application of commercial HVAC systems including rooftop units, air handling units, chillers, boilers, VAV systems, energy recovery equipment, and building automation integration in accordance with applicable codes including International Mechanical Code (IMC), ASHRAE standards, and local energy codes.
  • Collaborate with design engineers and contractors to influence basis-of-design specifications and ensure proper system integration.
  • Deliver technical product support, including submittal reviews, performance verification, and troubleshooting during installation and commissioning phases.
  • Maintain strong technical relationships with manufacturers to stay aligned on product capabilities, engineering updates, and application best practices.
  • Generate and present technical proposals, including equipment selections, system schematics, psychrometric analysis, and value-engineered alternatives.
  • Track and manage project pipelines through CRM tools, ensuring accurate forecasting and documentation of project milestones.
  • Participate in ongoing technical training, industry events, and manufacturer programs to maintain current knowledge of HVAC technologies, ASHRAE standards, and energy efficiency requirements.

Qualifications and Core Technical Competencies

  • The ideal candidate will have 5–7 years of experience in applied HVAC engineering, technical sales, or mechanical systems design within commercial or industrial markets.
  • Direct experience with commercial HVAC systems including air handlers, rooftop units, chillers, boilers, VAV systems, energy recovery equipment, or building automation is essential.
  • A Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline is preferred.
  • Strong understanding of HVAC system fundamentals is required, including psychrometries, airflow dynamics, heat transfer, refrigeration cycles, and hydronic system design.
  • Experience interpreting mechanical plans, specifications, and submittals is essential, along with familiarity with applicable codes and standards including International Mechanical Code (IMC), ASHRAE 90.1 energy standards, ASHRAE 62.1 ventilation requirements, and local building codes.
  • Ability to perform equipment selection and system-level analysis using manufacturer software and engineering tools such as load calculation programs, duct design software, and energy modeling applications is required.
  • High attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple complex projects concurrently is necessary. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, are essential.
  • Proven ability to negotiate and influence technical decisions in a competitive sales environment is required.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical insurance, a 401(k) plan with employer matching, paid time off (PTO), and paid holidays.

Compensation: Commission only, successful candidates can expect up to $105,000 DOE, plus car allowance and various paid expenses.

Nevada Systems Group is a part of Ambient Enterprises. Ambient is a collective of HVAC design and implementation experts, each entity esteemed in their respective regions, with decades of experience. Our experts merge craft with care, delivering safety, comfort, and highly efficient, sustainable solutions for spaces that  matter most: healthcare, commercial, and residential. We have over 1k employees across the US and Canada. title: Supervisor
description:
Job Description: Admin Support

Position Title: Admin Support
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Minimum Qualification: Graduate (mandatory)

Role Overview:

The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.

This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Site Operations Oversight:

  • Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
  • Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
  • Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
  • Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
  • Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
  • Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
  • Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost & found registers.
  • Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
  • Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.

2. Technical Systems & Documentation:

  • Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
  • Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
  • Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
  • Take access approvals via eApproval portals.

3. Reporting & MIS:

  • Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
  • Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
  • Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.

4. Emergency & Incident Management:

  • Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
  • Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
  • Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
  • Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.

5. Client & Stakeholder Coordination:

  • Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
  • Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
  • Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
  • Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.

6. G4S Internal Coordination:

  • Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
  • Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
  • Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
  • Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.

Candidate Profile:

Minimum Requirements:

  • Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
  • Minimum 5–10 years of experience in security operations management
  • Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
  • Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.

Essential Competencies:

  • Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
  • Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
  • Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
  • Leadership & Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
  • Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

  • 100% compliance in daily deployment & reporting
  • ≥95% uptime for security equipment and systems
  • ≤2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
  • SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
  • Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores ≥90%

title: Lead Mobile Engineer
description:
Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the country in which the role is being hired. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Mark43’s mission is to empower communities and their governments with new technologies that improve the safety and quality of life for all. We build powerful, scalable, and elegant software that sets a new standard for the tools upon which our first responders rely. Our users are diverse, and we are committed to embracing diversity of thought and experience within our team.

We're looking for a Lead iOS Engineer to define the future of mobile engineering at Mark43. You'll lead the technical direction of our iOS platform, mentor engineers, and partner closely with Android teammates to evolve our cross-platform strategy using Swift and Kotlin. As we continue investing in Kotlin Multiplatform, you'll help determine where shared code accelerates development while ensuring our iOS applications deliver a best-in-class native experience.

As a technical leader, you'll own major architectural decisions, drive engineering best practices, and help deliver mission-critical software that first responders rely on every day. This is an opportunity to shape not only the products we build, but also the future of mobile development at Mark43. This role will be based in Boston, MA and operates on a 3 day hybrid schedule.

What You'll Do

If you were part of our team, here are some things you would have done last week:

  • Led the design and implementation of new features for our mobile-first public safety platform using Swift and modern iOS frameworks.
  • Partnered with Android engineers to identify opportunities for shared business logic using Kotlin Multiplatform while preserving a best-in-class native iOS experience.
  • Defined the technical roadmap for our iOS platform, balancing long-term architecture with rapid customer delivery.
  • Collaborated closely with Product, Design, and Engineering to develop solutions that meet customer needs while maintaining a high bar for quality and performance.
  • Reviewed pull requests, mentored engineers, and helped establish engineering best practices around architecture, testing, and maintainability.
  • Improved CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and release processes to ensure reliable App Store deployments.
  • Investigated production issues, reduced technical debt, and drove architectural improvements that make the platform easier to build and maintain over time.

You should have:

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience developing native iOS applications with Swift.
  • Experience serving as a technical lead or senior engineer, driving architecture, mentoring teammates, and leading complex technical initiatives.
  • Deep expertise in modern iOS development, including Swift, Swift Concurrency, UIKit and/or SwiftUI, and Apple's current development best practices.
  • Strong experience with Kotlin and an understanding of cross-platform mobile architectures.
  • Experience shipping multiple production mobile applications from concept through App Store release.
  • Experience designing scalable application architecture and writing clean, maintainable, well-tested code.
  • Strong understanding of mobile testing strategies, CI/CD pipelines, and App Store release processes.
  • Experience integrating RESTful APIs and working with cloud-based backend services.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across Engineering, Product, and Design.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) and/or Compose Multiplatform (CMP).
  • Experience helping define or implement a shared mobile platform strategy across iOS and Android.
  • Familiarity with modern Android development practices.
  • Experience building software for highly regulated or mission-critical environments.

People who thrive on our team also tend to share the following characteristics:

  • Humble, open, and curious, always looking to learn from teammates and improve the way we build software.
  • Comfortable taking ownership of challenging technical problems while helping others succeed.
  • Passionate about building thoughtful, reliable software that users depend on in high-pressure situations.
  • Willing to empathize with users whose experiences may be very different from your own.
  • Detail-oriented with a strong commitment to quality, craftsmanship, and continuous improvement.

Position Summary:

The Transportation Analyst supports transportation planning, daily shipment execution, customer service, and performance reporting across the transportation network. This role combines analytical problem solving with service-oriented communication to improve shipment visibility, monitor on-time performance, support track-and-trace activity, identify trends and exceptions, and provide timely reporting and follow-up to carriers, internal stakeholders, and operations teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support transportation planning activities by reviewing shipment demand, routing requirements, carrier capacity, delivery schedules, and operational constraints.
  • Monitor shipment execution through track-and-trace activity, providing timely updates on shipment status, delivery expectations, appointment changes, and potential service risks.
  • Provide customer service support to carriers, internal teams, and business partners by responding to transportation inquiries, resolving shipment issues, and coordinating follow-up on exceptions.
  • Track, analyze, and report transportation KPIs including on-time pickup, on-time delivery, appointment adherence, shipment visibility, exception resolution time, carrier response time, and service issue trends.
  • Prepare on-time performance reporting and provide analysis on delays, missed appointments, late deliveries, root causes, and opportunities to improve service performance.
  • Analyze transportation data to identify trends, cost impacts, service gaps, network inefficiencies, and opportunities to improve planning, execution, and carrier performance.
  • Partner with Transportation, Planning, Logistics, Operations, Sales, Customer Service, and carrier partners to support daily execution, issue resolution, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Request, validate, and maintain accurate shipment, carrier, and transportation data to support reporting, performance analysis, and operational decision-making.
  • Review transportation reports and data for inconsistencies, missing information, shipment exceptions, and documentation gaps; seek clarification as needed to ensure accurate reporting and follow-up.
  • Assist with business cases, savings projections, operating budgets, and project start-ups by providing transportation data, KPI insights, and performance analysis.
  • Support continuous improvement efforts by identifying process gaps, recommending improvements, and helping standardize transportation planning, reporting, and communication processes.
  • Serve as cross-functional support for transportation planning and execution activities as needed to ensure operational continuity and consistent service levels.

Leadership Competencies

Education and Work History:

  • 3-5 yearsâ experience in Supply Chain/Transportation Analysis in CPG, Food Beverage or Third Party Logistics company.
  • Understanding of the North American transportation industry including dedicated/private fleet, TL, LTL (domestic and cross border), intermodal.
  • Highly proficient / advanced working knowledge in Microsoft Office (ie: Word, Excel, Access, Outlook, PowerPoint).
  • Experience/Exposure with logistics optimization tools (routing, transportation planning software) such as Appian, Paragon, JDA/Bule Yonder is a definite asset.
  • Working knowledge of TMS (Specially Oracle TMS) is an asset.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate clearly.
  • Strong customer service mindset with the ability to support carrier partners, internal stakeholders, and operations teams by proactively addressing service issues, communicating changes, and coordinating resolution of transportation exceptions.

description:

As a Project Engineer for Metalcraft of Mayville, you will be instrumental in product design from concept to production – complete ownership of design and validation. title: Principal Account Clerk
description:
The Metropolitan District Commission (MDC) provides quality water supply, water pollution control, mapping, and household hazardous waste collection to eight member municipalities: Bloomfield, East Hartford, Hartford, Newington, Rocky Hill, West Hartford, Wethersfield and Windsor. Additionally, the MDC provides drinking water to portions of Farmington, Glastonbury, East Granby and South Windsor, known as the MDC's non-member towns.

JOB SUMMARY


This is highly responsible financial and administrative position involving the processing and review of complex financial transactions, reconciling accounts, analyzing billing and collections data, monitoring vendor and customer account activity, and performing system-based financial tasks. This position requires analytical thinking and the ability to communicate effectively with internal departments and external stakeholders.

Position is being filled in the Treasury/Collections group and will be interacting with he District's water and sewer customers on a daily basis. Prior experience in accounts receivable/collections or in a customer service call center preferred. Must be comfortable with discussing past due balances, proficient in conflict resolution and possess strong negotiating skills.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS


The following duties are normal for this position. The omission of specific statements of the duties does not exclude them from the classification if the work is similar, related, or a logical assignment for this classification. Other duties may be required and assigned.
• Reviews, prepares, and processes financial transactions related to vendor payments and customer refunds.
• Audits, invoices, purchase orders, payment requests, and utility billing data to ensure accuracy and compliance with established policies.
• Enters and maintains financial data in SAP, including transaction postings, account adjustments, payment applications, and billing corrections.
• Performs account reconciliations involving vendor ledgers, customer accounts, and general ledger balances.
• Coordinates with internal departments (Customer Service, Field Operations, Engineering, Procurement and Finance) to resolve billing disputes, consumption anomalies, or payment discrepancies.
• Reviews aging reports and follows up on outstanding receivables; initiates payment plans or escalates for further action.
• Maintains accurate financial records and supporting documentation.
• Participates in process improvements, policy updates, and financial system upgrades or testing efforts. Identifies opportunities to streamline billing, payment, and reconciliation processes. Participates in cross-functional meetings to improve coordination between various departments.
• Assists customers, vendors and others with billing, invoice and payment inquiries. Handles difficult inquiries requiring in-depth knowledge of the activity, operations and recordkeeping system.
• Performs related work as required.

This position will work under the direction of the Chief Administrative Officer's office as a cross-training, developmental position to be assigned across business units and functions, including accounts payable, collections, and customer service/billing on an as needed basis. Experience using SAP or any other ERP system to process invoices a plus. Experience developing job aids is desired. Outstanding communication, organization and collaboration skills a must for this position.


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
Associates degree from a recognized college or university, plus four (4) years of progressively responsible accounting, customer service, accounts payable, and/or related clerical experience, preferably in the utility industry, or any equivalent combination of education and/or experience that provides the requisite experience.

SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS
Must have a valid driver's license.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES
• Knowledge of account clerical procedures and techniques.
• Knowledge of MDC billing processes and financial systems.
• Knowledge of general office and recordkeeping procedures.
• Knowledge of the operations of standard office machines and a computer terminal and personal computer.
• Knowledge of business English.
• Skill in mathematical computation.
• Skill in keyboard operation including a computer terminal and typewriter.
• Ability in oral communications and good ability in written communications.
• Ability to follow oral and written instructions.
• Ability to perform administrative procedures.
• Ability to learn the operations of the assigned department.
• Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with coworkers, customers and the general public.
• Ability to research and resolve accounts payable issues with customers and vendors.

ADA COMPLIANCE
Physical Ability: Tasks require the ability to exert light physical effort in a sedentary to light work environment, which may involve some lifting, carrying, pushing and/or pulling of objects and materials of light weight (under 25 pounds).

Sensory Requirements: Some tasks require the ability to perceive and discriminate visual cues or signals. Some tasks require the ability to communicate orally and in writing.

title: Mission Coach (3424)
description:
Summary:

The Mission Coach implements and delivers short-term case management services, and training for Goodwill South Florida staff through regular in-person or virtual meetings to assess needs, and progress, while providing support, and offering encouragement. The Coach helps staff strengthen problem-solving skills, develop life skills, set priorities, and identify personal values. The Mission Coach service addresses fragmentation within the social services system by utilizing a holistic, whole-family approach that is foundational to Goodwill’s wrap-around services for staff and their families. The Mission Coach supports participants in preparing for long-term success through employment readiness, financial management, future planning, and education. In addition, the Coach networks with external resources to promote Goodwill’s programs, manage community outreach, and build strong relationships with stakeholders to ensure cross referrals, working with minimal supervision and exercising self-direction to achieve organizational goals.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Provide career navigation, coaching, and stabilization services to support participants in advancing toward educational and employment goals.
  • Deliver holistic, comprehensive, strengths-based short-term case management using a whole-family approach.
  • Conduct comprehensive strength discovery assessments to identify participants’ strengths, family support, academic challenges, risks, and barriers across multiple life domains (individual, family, school, and community).
  • Develop individualized short- and long-term goals, action plans, and progress monitoring strategies aligned with assessment results, including applicable PYDI tools.
  • Meet with participants on a weekly or bi-weekly basis, in person or virtually, based on identified needs.
  • Engage parents and caregivers to build rapport and provide ongoing support, referrals, and connections to services; maintain availability during evenings and weekends as needed.
  • Provide support services that enhance participant success, including community referrals, employment opportunities, and job retention coaching.
  • Assess staff/participants to determine areas of assistance needed and connect them to appropriate internal and external resources.
  • Coach participants to act on and achieve long-term educational, training, and employment goals through one-on-one and group-based interventions.
  • Monitor, evaluate, and document participant progress; provide guidance, counseling, and motivational coaching to address challenges and revise goals as needed.
  • Organize and deliver job readiness and employment preparation activities in individual and group settings.
  • Stay informed on current labor market trends to provide timely and relevant employment information.
  • Build, maintain, and leverage relationships with community partners, employers, educational institutions, and service providers to enhance wrap-around services.
  • Serve as the primary liaison for community partner referrals and coordination of services.
  • Ensure timely, accurate, and confidential documentation of participant information in required databases, forms, and reports.
  • Comply with agency policies, procedures, and Commission on Accreditation of Rehabilitation Facilities (CARF) standards.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Experience providing counseling to diverse adult populations a plus.
  • Must have the ability to establish and maintain good working relationships with community partners.
  • Must be flexible, multi-task orientated, and able to prioritize job duties with minimal supervision, including flexibility in work hours.
  • Must always exercise discretion and confidentiality.
  • Must attend required meetings.
  • Must have good written and computer skills necessary to perform job duties.
  • Must follow all safety procedures and correct safety issues, if possible.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license and have access to a reliable vehicle.
  • Able to operate a computer and MS Office software including Word and Excel.
  • Ability to listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences and communicate information and ideas in speaking so others will understand.
  • Demonstrates responsible behavior, initiative, effort and commitment towards completing assignments efficiently. Demonstrate problem-solving skills and pays attention to detail.

title: Hawaii Military Training & Engagement Coordinator
description:
Company Overview:

ANSER enhances national and homeland security by strengthening public institutions. We provide thought leadership for complex issues through independent analysis, and we deliver practical, useful solutions. ANSER values collaboration, integrity, and initiative and we are client focused in all that we do. Because we were established for the purpose of public service and not for profit, we measure our success in the impact of our service.

Position Overview

ANSER has an immediate opening for a Hawaii Military Training & Engagement Coordinator to support the Hawaii Coordination Cell (HCC) Executive Director in advancing national defense objectives through education, engagement, and relationship building across Hawaii. In this role, you will coordinate, administer, and oversee recurring cultural awareness training for military personnel and Department of War civilians while supporting specialized Hawaii Perspectives courses for senior military and Department of War leaders. You will work closely with military installations and Native Hawaiian Organizations to enhance understanding of Hawaii's customs, practices, language, history, and perspectives, strengthening relationships between the military and Hawaii's communities.

Day to Day Responsibilities

  • Coordinate Hawaii 101 training across five military Services located in Hawaii.
  • Manage the administration and scheduling of weekly, monthly, quarterly, and special event training activities.
  • Coordinate training requirements with military installation representatives based on incoming personnel schedules.
  • Validate the successful execution of training delivered by Native Hawaiian Organizations.
  • Plan and execute multi-day Hawaii Perspectives Courses for senior military and Department of War officials.
  • Coordinate course logistics, participant registration, training materials, facilities, and event support.
  • Maintain training records and prepare reports documenting training completion and program execution.
  • Collaborate with military organizations, government stakeholders, Native Hawaiian Organizations, and community partners to ensure effective program delivery.
  • Promote greater understanding of Hawaii's customs, practices, language, history, and perspectives to support successful interactions between military personnel and Hawaii residents, businesses, and community organizations.
  • Support the Hawaii Coordination Cell Executive Director in initiatives that preserve and protect land in Hawaiʻi while building and maintaining trust with the people of Hawaiʻi through military education and engagement.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of experience coordinating training programs, educational initiatives, or event planning activities.
  • Ability to obtain Secret security clearance.
  • Knowledge of Department of War organizational structure and military Service organizations.
  • Experience coordinating recurring training events involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Experience providing administrative support for training, education, or outreach programs.
  • Experience coordinating with government organizations or military installations

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree from an accredited college or university.
  • Ten (10) or more years of experience supporting military training, education, or event planning programs.
  • Experience working with military organizations in Hawaii.
  • Experience collaborating with Native Hawaiian Organizations or community engagement initiatives.
  • Experience supporting senior military or Department of War leadership programs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience managing multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.

title: Field Engineer
description:
Our mission is to transform how people and machines work together to push the boundaries of human productivity. We're looking for team members excited to partner with the world's manufacturers and build the future of production together.

As a Field Engineer, you will be the face of Augury in the field, traveling extensively primarily across the United States, but also globally, to install, implement, and support our solutions.

This role requires a unique blend of mechanical aptitude, technical expertise, and customer-facing professionalism. You will ensure our hardware and services are deployed correctly, operate reliably, and deliver measurable value to customers.

This position is based in the Northeast or Midwest US and requires residence within one hour of a major airport.

A Day in Your Life

  • Travel 80–90% of the time to support customer sites

We offer several perks that include flexible PTO, medical/dental/vision insurance, 401(k) match, stock options, paid parental leave, and WFH and phone stipend.

title: Network Technician - Copper & Fiber Specialist
description:
Welcome to ConocoPhillips, where innovation and excellence create a platform for opportunity and growth. Come realize your full potential here.

Who We Are

We are one of the world’s largest independent exploration and production companies, based on proved reserves and production of liquids and natural gas. With operations and activities in 13 countries, we explore for, develop, and produce crude oil and natural gas globally. We are challenged with an important job to safely find and deliver energy to the world. Our employees are critical to our success, and with them we power civilization.

We’re grounded by our SPIRIT Values – safety, people, integrity, responsibility, innovation, and teamwork. These values position us to deliver strong performance in a dynamic business – but not at all costs. We believe it’s not just what we do – it’s how we do it – that sets us apart.

Fostering an Inclusive Work Environment

To deliver superior performance, we create an environment that respects the contributions and differences of every individual. Wherever possible, we use these differences to drive competitive business advantage, personal growth and, ultimately, create business success.

Job Summary

Alaska Overview
The Alaska segment primarily explores for, produces, transports and markets crude oil, natural gas and NGLs. We are the largest crude oil producer in Alaska and have major ownership interests in the Prudhoe Bay, Kuparuk and Western North Slope asset areas. Additionally, we are one of Alaska’s largest owners of state, federal and fee exploration leases, with approximately one million net undeveloped acres at year-end 2025. Alaska operations contributed 12 percent of our consolidated liquids production and one percent of our consolidated natural gas production.

In 2025, net crude oil production for Alaska averaged 199 MBOED.

Western North Slope Overview
The Western North Slope includes the Bear Tooth Unit (as highlighted above), the Colville River Unit and the Greater Mooses Tooth Unit. These units also leverage shared regional infrastructure, which underpins base operations and facilitates continued development across the Western North Slope. In 2025, we operated one part-time drilling rig in the Colville River Unit. The Colville River Unit includes the Alpine Field and four satellite fields. Field installations include one central production facility, which separates oil, natural gas and water. The Greater Mooses Tooth Unit is the first unit established entirely within the National Petroleum Reserve Alaska (NPRA). The unit was constructed in two phases: Greater Mooses Tooth #1 (GMT1) and Greater Mooses Tooth #2 (GMT2).

In 2025, net crude oil production in the Western North Slope averaged 39 MBOED.

Position Overview

The Network Technician – Copper & Fiber Specialist is responsible for the installation, maintenance, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting of copper and fiber optic network infrastructure supporting the Willow Development. This role focuses on the physical layer of the network, including structured cabling systems, fiber optic transport, labeling, testing, and accurate documentation, while supporting site networking and telecommunications connectivity in a challenging Arctic environment and maintaining alignment with corporate standards.

This is a North Slope-based rotational role working a 2 week on/2 week off schedule supporting the Willow Project.

Your responsibilities may include:

Copper & Fiber Infrastructure:

  • Install, terminate, label, and test copper (Cat5e/Cat6/Cat6A) and fiber optic cabling (single mode and multi mode).
  • Perform fiber splicing, polishing, and enclosure management.
  • Conduct OTDR, power meter, and copper/fiber certification testing.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot patch panels, fiber distribution frames (FDFs), network cabinets, and pathway systems.
  • Assist with troubleshooting physical layer connectivity issues impacting site networks and critical operational systems.

Documentation & Asset Management:

  • Develop, update, and maintain accurate copper and fiber documentation, including cable schedules, strand assignments, labeling records, and as built drawings.
  • Ensure documentation is updated for all moves, adds, and changes to the cable documentation.
  • Maintain accurate cable plant and network asset inventory in ServiceNow.
  • Support audits by validating physical infrastructure against documented records.

Network & Telecommunications Support:

  • Provide day to day support for LAN/WAN, and Wi Fi connectivity related to copper and fiber infrastructure.
  • Support structured cabling and physical connectivity for operational, industrial, and business network services as required.
  • Utilize network monitoring and approved diagnostic tools to assist in troubleshooting cabling and connectivity issues.

Design, Coordination & Operations:

  • Assist with copper and fiber cable plant design, routing, and capacity planning for new and existing facilities.
  • Plan and perform cabling maintenance and upgrade activities to minimize impact to North Slope operations.
  • Work with vendors to develop Bills of Materials for cabling and network projects.
  • Coordinate with internal Supply Chain partners to procure materials, equipment, and services.
  • Develop and provide end user or site training related to cabling and connectivity as required.

Safety, Performance & Collaboration:

  • Actively participate in ConocoPhillips safety processes and comply with all safety policies and procedures.
  • Take ownership of assigned work and follow through on commitments.
  • Collaborate with global IT, telecom, and network peers to maintain alignment with corporate standards.
  • Build positive working relationships based on trust, accountability, and open communication.
  • Deliver results safely, ethically, and on schedule in a challenging Arctic environment.

Success Profile

To thrive in this role, you’ll demonstrate the following Leadership Competencies:

  • Takes Accountability: Takes ownership of actions and follows through on commitments by courageously dealing with important problems, holding others accountable, and standing up for what is right
  • Partners Collaboratively: Builds positive relationships based on trust and seeks collaboration across organizational boundaries to achieve goals
  • Makes Decisions: Generates effective solutions based on available information and makes timely decisions that are safe and ethical

Basic/Required:

  • Legally authorized to work in the United States
  • Current/valid driver’s license
  • 5 or more years of experience supporting copper and fiber optic infrastructure in an industrial or enterprise environment
  • 1 or more years of experience with fiber optic transport technologies, testing, and troubleshooting
  • 1 or more years of experience maintaining accurate cable plant documentation and as built records
  • Willing and able (with or without reasonable accommodation) to work in a remote work location on a 2 weeks on/2 weeks off work schedule
  • Willing and able to meet the physical demands and work environment requirements outlined in this job description, with or without reasonable accommodation

Preferred:

  • BICSI Technician, FOA CFOT, or equivalent copper/fiber certifications
  • Cisco CCNA certification or equivalent foundational networking knowledge
  • 1 or more years of experience performing elevated or tower work to maintain communications systems
  • Intermediate knowledge of network monitoring and management tools such as SolarWinds Orion and Cisco Prime
  • Intermediate knowledge of IP‑based video surveillance and access control cabling
  • Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills
  • Ability to adapt to new tools, techniques, and technologies
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver results, meet commitments, and adhere to deadlines
  • Strong commitment to safety, ethics, accountability, and inclusive collaboration

Physical Demands & Work Environment

  • Perform physical tasks such as climbing ladders or towers, working in confined spaces, standing, walking, and lifting materials in Arctic conditions
  • Work both in and out of a company-provided vehicle
  • Wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE)

title: Security Operations Center (SOC) Officer
description:
Security Operation Center Officer (SOC Operator)

Site: Rahway, New Jersey

Shifts Available: 1500-2300 and 2300-0700

Pay rate: $26.50

Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and technologically savvy Security Operations Center (SOC) Operator to support our Security Operations Center. This role is critical in monitoring systems, identifying risks, and ensuring timely escalation and communication of security-related activity. The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in security, situational awareness, and the ability to interpret and act on information from multiple systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor security systems, alarms, and CCTV feeds to identify unusual activity, potential risks, and security incidents
  • Maintain heightened awareness and respond appropriately to alarms, safety issues, and emerging situations
  • Accurately interpret CCTV and system data and determine next steps, including notifications, escalation, and documentation
  • Prepare clear, detailed written reports and provide timely verbal notifications to appropriate stakeholders
  • Utilize technology-based security platforms and tools as part of daily operations
  • Work collaboratively with site leadership and control personnel who manage response actions
  • Conduct system checks to ensure all monitoring equipment is functioning properly
  • Track and escalate suspicious activity or operational concerns
  • Support investigations by reviewing video footage and compiling evidence
  • Maintain confidentiality of sensitive information and security procedures
  • Provide excellent customer service while maintaining a professional present.

Please note: SOC Operators typically monitor video and systems at a workstation or desk; response actions are coordinated through designated personnel.

Required Qualifications

  • 18 years of age or older.
  • High School Diploma or GED Required.
  • Security experience may vary, but must include:
    • Prior leadership experience or documented training demonstrating advanced situational awareness
    • Experience responding to risks, unusual activity, and alarm events
  • Relevant experience with technology-based security systems (GSOC, SOC, or similar environments preferred)
  • CCTV experience with a clear understanding of:
    • How to analyze what is being viewed
    • What actions are taken with that information
    • Proper reporting, notifications, and escalation procedures
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to remain calm, professional, and focused in fast-paced or high-pressure situations
  • Ability to prepare and distribute daily weather reports that may impact employee movement, site operations, or security activities.
  • Active NJ SORA license or the ability to obtain one, valid driver's license, and open availability is required for this position.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in a GSOC or SOC environment
  • Previous supervisory experience
  • Familiarity with report writing related to security incidents
  • Experience working with monitoring platforms, alarm management systems, and access control technology
  • Strong attention to detail and situational awareness
  • Ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment

What We Offer:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, AD&D, and Disability Insurance
  • 401K Retirement Options
  • Paid Time Off
  • Weekly Pay
  • Paid Training & Free Uniforms
  • Employee Discounts (Retail, Phone Plans, Rentals & more)
  • Pet Daycare Discounts
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Career Advancement Opportunities

title: IN-VAS L1 Operations Engineer
description:
Description:

Job Description (JD): IN-VAS L1 Operations Engineer

IN-VAS L1 Operations Engineer

Role Summary

The IN-VAS L1 Operations Engineer is responsible for 24x7 monitoring, fault management, and first-level support of Intelligent Network (IN) and Value Added Services (VAS) platforms. The role ensures service availability, quick incident detection, initial troubleshooting, escalation management, and operational excellence to meet agreed SLAs.

Key Responsibilities

Monitoring & Incident Management

  • Monitor IN and VAS network elements, applications, and services using NMS/OSS tools.
  • Detect, analyze, and troubleshoot alarms and service degradations.
  • Perform first-level fault isolation and restoration activities.
  • Escalate unresolved issues to L2/L3 teams and vendors as per escalation matrix.
  • Track incidents until closure and ensure compliance with SLAs.

Operational Support

  • Perform routine health checks and service validation.
  • Execute standard operating procedures (SOPs) and work instructions.
  • Monitor platform performance, capacity, and availability.
  • Support scheduled maintenance activities and change implementations.
  • Validate services after maintenance and upgrades.

Reporting & Documentation

  • Maintain incident logs and operational records.
  • Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports.
  • Document outages, actions taken, root cause summaries, and lessons learned.
  • Update knowledge base and operational procedures.

Customer & Stakeholder Coordination

  • Coordinate with Operations, Engineering, IT, Vendor, and Customer teams.
  • Provide timely status updates during major incidents.
  • Participate in bridge calls and incident review meetings.

Technical Skills Required

Telecom Domain

  • Intelligent Network (IN) platforms.
  • VAS platforms such as SMSC, USSD, IVR, CRBT, SDP, Charging Systems, and Messaging platforms.
  • GSM/UMTS/LTE/VoLTE network fundamentals.
  • SS7, SIGTRAN, SIP, Diameter protocols.
  • Basic understanding of Core Network architecture.

Tools & Technologies

  • NMS/OSS Monitoring Tools.
  • Ticketing systems (Remedy, ServiceNow, Jira, etc.).
  • Linux/Unix fundamentals.
  • Basic SQL/Database knowledge.
  • Log analysis and troubleshooting tools.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Telecommunications, Computer Science, or related field.
  • 1-5 years of experience in Telecom Operations, IN, Core Network, or VAS Operations.
  • Experience in 24x7 Network Operations Center (NOC) environment preferred.

Key Competencies

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
  • Effective communication and stakeholder management.
  • Ability to work in shifts and under pressure.
  • Customer-focused approach.
  • Team collaboration and incident management skills.

KPIs

  • Incident response and resolution time.
  • Service availability and uptime.
  • SLA compliance.
  • Alarm handling efficiency.
  • Escalation and ticket closure performance.

Typical Designation: IN-VAS L1 Operations Engineer / NOC Engineer / Operations Executive.

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.
