Briotix Health is seeking a full-time Industrial Sports Medicine Professional!

Position Overview:
The Industrial Sports Medicine Professional is responsible for providing onsite care to the working athletes we serve by being the expert in job function and technical task analysis, maintaining a thorough understanding of functional body movements, discomforts, and following established OSHA First Aid standards and guidelines.

This position is an integral part of the Industrial Sports Medicine Service line and will collaborate with other Briotix Health key stakeholders. The goals of the position are to develop strong relationships, provide injury prevention & early discomfort management (EDM) programs, and assist in providing ergonomic solutions to Briotix Health’s clients.

While we must meet our contractual client expectations, Briotix Health values work/life balance. If you thrive in a people-focused environment and are great at working autonomously, you could be a terrific fit for this role.

Company Perks:

  • Excellent benefits package including Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance
  • Flex Spending Accounts
  • 401k/ROTH IRA with employer match
  • Company Sponsored Group Life Insurance, AD&D and Long-Term Disability
  • Professional Development Reimbursement
  • Accrued Paid Time Off, up to 120 hours in the first year
  • 7 Company Paid Holidays + 2 Floating Holidays of your choice
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and Annual Calm.com subscription
  • Annual PPE reimbursement, based on client requirements
  • MedBridge Discount
  • Work/Life Balance
  • Opportunities for professional development and specialized training
  • Mentorship programs
  • DEI=B Focus Groups

Job Duties:

  • Provide on-site services at one location in Columbia, SC.
  • Create and maintain positive relationships between Briotix Health and client contacts.
  • Initiate and establish professional and engaging relationships with client employees.
  • Provide education & training for individuals and groups focused on injury and illness prevention.
  • Provide onsite care and management of work and non-work-related discomforts.
  • Maintain a thorough knowledge of OSHA Health and Safety practices and follow established OSHA First Aid standards and guidelines.
  • Understand, implement, and follow all steps of the Early Discomfort Management (EDM) program.
  • Based on client requirements, you may provide Functional Employment Testing, Return to Work/Stay at Work Services, Ergonomic Assessments (including on-site, virtual, office, and vehicle), or Clinical Solutions.
  • Detailed and timely reports are required for each of the services that you complete.
  • Maintain accurate and timely documentation using Briotix Health’s designated web-based system.
  • Adhere to all safety policies, procedures, and regulatory standards in place for each specified worksite.

title: Health & Safety Director
description:
What you'll bring to the team

Health & Safety Director – Thorpe Park Resort

Thorpe Park Resort, Chertsey Surrey

Our Purpose: Bring Every Family Closer Through Play

Our Vision: To Be The Worlds Most Loved Family Escape

At Merlin Entertainments, our purpose is simple: to bring every family closer through play. Every day, millions of guests create unforgettable memories across our world-famous attractions, and behind every magical experience is an unwavering commitment to safety.

We're looking for an exceptional Health & Safety Director to join the Senior Leadership Team at Thorpe Park Resort.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the health and safety strategy for one of the UK's most exciting visitor attractions, leading a high-performing team while ensuring our guests, colleagues and contractors can enjoy and deliver extraordinary experiences safely.

If you're a strategic safety leader who thrives in fast-paced, operational environments and enjoys influencing at the highest level, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

As Health & Safety Director, you'll provide both strategic direction and operational leadership for all aspects of health and safety across the resort.

Reporting to the UK Health, Safety & Security Director and working closely with the Site Vice President and Senior Leadership Team, you'll champion a proactive safety culture, ensuring compliance with legislation while driving continuous improvement across every area of the business.

You'll be a trusted advisor to senior leaders, supporting major operational decisions, future developments and investment projects whilst leading a visible, engaged Health & Safety team.

This role also plays an important part in incident management and crisis response, participating in the local Incident Director rota when required. This will include some evening and weekend work.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be responsible for:

  • Leading the overall health and safety strategy across Thorpe Park Resort.
  • Inspiring, developing and managing the Health & Safety team.
  • Providing expert advice and guidance to leaders across all departments.
  • Driving a positive, proactive safety culture through coaching, visibility and engagement.
  • Ensuring compliance with UK legislation, Merlin standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Managing audits, inspections, reporting and governance activities.
  • Maintaining the resort risk register and ensuring actions are delivered.
  • Supporting capital projects, new attractions and resort developments from a safety perspective.
  • Managing incident investigations, corrective actions and regulatory reporting.
  • Building strong relationships with external agencies including the HSE, Environmental Health, Police and Local Authorities.
  • Managing departmental budgets including both OPEX and CAPEX planning.

Qualifications & Experience

What We're Looking For

You'll bring significant leadership experience together with a genuine passion for creating safe environments where both people and businesses can thrive.

You'll ideally have:

  • NEBOSH Diploma (or equivalent).
  • A minimum of 10 years' experience within Health & Safety leadership.
  • Experience leading high-performing teams.
  • Strong knowledge of UK Health & Safety legislation and best practice.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills.
  • Experience working with senior leadership teams and executive stakeholders.
  • Membership of a recognised professional body (or willingness to obtain this).
  • Experience within hospitality, leisure, attractions, or another operationally complex/ public facing environment.

The Kind of Leader You Are

We're looking for someone who naturally demonstrates our leadership behaviours:

Soulfully Curious

You enjoy learning, ask thoughtful questions and continually seek better ways of working.

Results Focused

You set high standards, take ownership and consistently deliver meaningful outcomes.

Extraordinary Teammate

You build trusted relationships, collaborate across teams and help others succeed.

Develops People

You coach, mentor and empower others to grow, creating an environment where people perform at their best.

Why Merlin?

This is more than a Health & Safety role. You'll have the opportunity to influence the future of one of the UK's most iconic resorts, working alongside passionate experts who genuinely care about creating unforgettable experiences safely.

At Merlin, safety isn't just about compliance—it's about enabling millions of families to make lifelong memories with confidence.

If you're ready to lead with purpose and make a lasting impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Together, we'll continue bringing every family closer through play.

Summary

Reporting to the Operations Leaders, Cardiac Sciences Program and working with the medical staff, Clinical Nurse Specialists, Access Leader and Patient Representative, the Cardiovascular Program Coordinator takes a leadership role in developing, implementing, evaluating and coordinating a cardiovascular waitlist management system. The Cardiovascular Program Coordinator as a key member of the Cardiac Sciences Program management team, plays an integral role in facilitating a patient-specific plan that establishes a streamlined process, timely and appropriate access and placement to necessary care, support and information to patients, families and referring Physicians waiting for cardiac surgery or intervention. The Cardiovascular Program Coordinator works closely with the BC Cardiac Registry and other Cardiovascular Program Coordinators at cardiac centres in the region and the province to ensure efficient and equitable access to cardiac services for all BC patients. The Coordinator also provides work direction to Booking Clerks in Surgery and Cardiology.Deadline to Apply: Tuesday, August 4th at 12:00 PM PST

What You Bring

Education:

  • Master's Degree in Health Administration or Master's Degree in a health sciences discipline
  • Three (3) to five (5) years' recent cardiac experience in a large, complex health care environment with expertise in program development and project management, or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience

Skills and Abilities:

  • Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing
  • Comprehensive knowledge of health care delivery systems
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and in collaboration/consultation with others
  • Demonstrated skills in leadership, communication, mediation and negotiation
  • Demonstrated skills in the application of communications and computerized technology to address communication needs and information analysis
  • Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced environment, under pressure and maintain priorities
  • Demonstrated ability to think laterally, solve problems, make decisions and take action in a crisis management environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work diplomatically and persuasively to establish and maintain effective work relationships with internal and external stakeholders

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary: The typical hiring range for this position is $46.37-57.96 per hour depending on experience. The full salary range is $46.37-$66.65 per hour.
  • A comprehensive health benefits package.
  • Meaningful impact: Your dedication and expertise will directly impact the lives of our patients.
  • Growth opportunities: We welcome individuals at all stages of their career, offering opportunities for professional development and growth.
  • Inclusive culture: We respect the diversity, dignity and interdependence of all persons. We value the cultural richness that our diverse workforce brings to the care of our equally diverse population of patients and residents.

Your Day to Day:

  • Assumes a leadership role in collaboration with other Cardiovascular Program Coordinators and the BC Cardiac Registry in developing and implementing a cardiovascular waitlist management system. Develops processes and tools for ongoing evaluation and revision for the system, as necessary. .
  • Establishes systems and processes to assist referring physicians in triage of patients for cardiac catheterization, cardiac intervention, and cardiac surgery, within the institution, and between institutions to facilitate timely access to cardiac services by ensuring that referrals are dealt with in a timely manner and include complete demographic, clinical, and contact information, as well as relative urgency. Referring physicians are provided with accurate on-call and resource information to assist in referral decision-making. Referrals are forwarded to the appropriate cardiologist, angioplaster, or cardiac surgeon as per the institutional policy. Communication is facilitated between the health care providers involved in the patient's care. .
  • In collaboration with the British Columbia Cardiac Registry, participates in development, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of a current, complete, and accurate database for all patients awaiting cardiac surgery at the Hospital, including tracking of patients waiting times and stability while awaiting cardiac surgery, cardiac intervention and diagnostic catheterization. Maintains current waiting lists, identifying patients exceeding recommended maximum waiting time. Ensures, in conjunction with the British Columbia Cardiac Registry, that statistics for waiting lists and cases completed are complete and recorded in the database in a timely manner. .
  • Establishes systems for notification of cardiac surgeons, cardiologists, and referring physicians of changes in patients' conditions. Works with physicians to develop options to facilitate patients having procedures completed recommended waiting time guidelines.
  • Provides patient/family centered support and educational information to patients waiting cardiac surgery, cardiac intervention or diagnostics by facilitating referrals to appropriate services (counseling, risk factor modification, and cardiac rehabilitation) internally or externally based on assessment of patient needs and services availability.
  • Provides a key liaison function for external and internal providers and patients. Provides pertinent information to stakeholders using a variety of communications media including verbal, written and electronic methods to facilitate decision-making and timely access to care. Communicates and collaborates with Cardiovascular Program Coordinators in other health care institutions in BC and the BC Cardiac Registry.
  • Develops and implements a joint triage system with an appeal process, for both the interventional cardiologists and cardiac surgeons, to ensure timely case review and patient selection. .
  • Addresses system gaps impacting on quality of patient care such as pre-admission patient education, communication re wait list status, ongoing telephone support to wait listed patients, coordination of in-patient versus out-patient scheduling priorities and coordinating triage rounds to ensure the most urgent cases take priority and to ensure improvement to the current waitlist management for both interventional cardiology and cardiac surgery. .
  • Works closely with the Director of the Cardiac Registry and other Cardiovascular Program Coordinators to integrate tracking of quality indicators and outcomes. Prepares and presents monthly statistics to the cardiac program team. Leads and/or participates in Continuous Quality Improvement initiatives to optimize program effectiveness and efficiency. .
  • Sets measurable goals and objectives within a team or individual environment, incorporating the Hospital's vision and values, goals and corporate plan, through methods such as updating own knowledge of clinical and professional development within area of practice, and developing plan in collaboration with the Operations Leaders; reviews progress to ensure that goals are achieved within established timeframes.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

description:
Department:

WDTech - R&D

We are Walker & Dunlop. We are one of the largest providers of capital to the commercial real estate industry, enabling real estate owners and operators to bring their visions of communities — where people live, work, shop, and play — to life. We are committed to creating meaningful social, environmental, and economic change in our communities.

Department Overview

WDTech is W&D’s in-house technology team – a group of collaborative and highly skilled technology professionals, all of whom are leading experts in real estate data, data science, and technology.

WDTech Engineering builds solutions that impact not only our products but also the people and processes across our organization. A commitment to innovation and a passion for disrupting the old-fashioned real estate industry are our highest priorities.

The Impact You Will Have

As a Business Systems Analyst, you will help design, support, and enhance the business applications that power critical workflows across the organization. Working closely with business stakeholders, Product Management, Product Design, and engineering teams, you will gather requirements, document business processes, configure systems, and support application enhancements that improve operational efficiency and user experience.

In this role, you will contribute to the modernization of internal platforms, including FileMaker applications, Azure SQL integrations, and connected business systems. Your work will help deliver scalable solutions that improve data quality, streamline workflows, and support evolving business needs.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Support the design, configuration, enhancement, and maintenance of scalable, high-quality FileMaker applications across new and existing business solutions.
  • Gather, analyze, and document business and functional requirements for new initiatives and system enhancements.
  • Collaborate with Product Management, Product Design, engineering teams, and business stakeholders to translate business needs into practical, scalable technical solutions.
  • Support the development, testing, and maintenance of system integrations, including Azure SQL, iManage, and internal and external APIs.
  • Assist with application testing, release validation, troubleshooting, and post-release support to ensure system quality and reliability.
  • Create and maintain process documentation, system documentation, and user support materials.
  • Identify opportunities to improve business processes, data quality, and application performance.
  • Perform other duties as assigned
  • Attendance is generally required from 8:30 am – 5:30 pm local time, Tuesday through Thursday, with the option to work remotely on Mondays and Fridays.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
  • 1+ years of experience as a Business Systems Analyst or in a related role supporting business applications, systems implementation, or process improvement preferred.
  • Experience gathering business requirements and partnering with stakeholders to support application development or system enhancements.
  • Experience working with relational databases, SQL, Microsoft Excel, or reporting tools.
  • Experience with FileMaker, low-code platforms, or business application configuration is preferred.
  • Experience in real estate, financial services, affordable housing, capital markets, or a related industry is preferred.


Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.

  • Demonstrated ownership, initiative, and a commitment to continuous learning and process improvement.

  • Courtesy, respect, and thoughtfulness in teaming with colleagues and other stakeholders

POSITION SCOPE AND ORGANIZATIONAL IMPACT

The Project Engineer, Energy Preconstruction supports the front-end development of Moss’s utility-scale energy EPC projects. This entry-level role provides vital coordination and technical support during the preconstruction phase—specifically in the preparation of proposals, management of RFPs/RFIs, document control, and project planning activities.

Serving as a critical connector between Estimating, Engineering, Procurement, and Operations, this role offers early exposure to the full project lifecycle and is designed as a foundation for career growth within Moss's energy division.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support the development and submission of responses to Requests for Proposals (RFPs), RFIs, and RFQs for utility-scale solar and BESS projects.

  • Assist in analyzing solicitation documents to identify key proposal requirements, strategy, and response structure.

  • Prepare, format, and manage high volumes of client-facing documents, proposals, and reports.

  • Track and manage proposal timelines, deliverables, and internal deadlines to ensure on-time submission.

  • Monitor relevant competitive procurement opportunities, managing the bid opportunities pipeline and circulating opportunities to the appropriate stakeholders.

  • Maintain, augment, and improve library of reusable components, templates, and processes to reduce response time and improve quality on future bids.

  • Contribute to a collaborative team environment by sharing insights, offering process improvements, and helping teammates where needed.

  • Demonstrate a learning mindset by seeking feedback, gaining technical knowledge about solar and BESS construction, and building cross-functional awareness.

EDUCATION AND WORK EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s in Construction Management, Engineering, Business, or related field.

  • 0-1+ years of experience in solar, BESS, construction, or estimating (internships included).

  • Strong writing, organization, and multitasking skills.

  • Proficient in MS Office; experience with Smartsheet, Bluebeam, or estimating tools is a plus.

  • Team-oriented, detail-focused, and eager to grow in the solar and BESS construction industry.

  • Proven ability to work across organizations with effective communication, leadership, and project management skills.

  • Proven attention to detail.

  • Excellent writing, grammar, and spelling ability.

  • Excellent presentation and written/oral communication skills.

  • Ability to work in a deadline-conscious, results-driven environment.

  • Ability to travel up to 10% to complete pre-bid site visits during the bid process.
